name: Tom Fitton
subject: Important Election Lawsuit Update
body:
Secret Service in a Tailspin!

[INSIDE JW]

Judicial Watch to Monitor Wisconsin Polls, Sets Up Election Fraud
Report Hot Line

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70840&L=33749&F=T&&hash=1e6d1e588a616ff99a5853994b69c5e09f07c6e9b1005bf24f0cbff27856c02e]
With the election less than two weeks away, Judicial Watch is
preparing to monitor Wisconsin polls and is setting up a National
Election Fraud Report Line for voters to report voting issues as part
of our ongoing election integrity efforts. Our trained observers will
monitor polling sites in Wisconsin on November 5. Separately, Judicial
Watch will run an Internet hotline
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70840&L=33719&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanVkaWNpYWwtd2F0Y2gtZWxlY3Rpb24tZnJhdWQtcmVwb3J0LWxpbmUtMi8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=7c69744f36e8468aef5a27faf4064b56f3a3c69bfa3385d80a992de80a78bebc]
for
voters in all states to report suspicions of election and voter fraud.

We monitor elections to ensure compliance with state and federal laws.
Judicial Watch’s election observers have monitored many state and
national elections and have been certified and served as international
election observers.

Our lead election law attorney, Robert Popper, established Judicial
Watch’s election monitoring program. Popper is a former deputy chief
of the Voting Section in the Civil Rights Division of the Department
of Justice and a veteran poll observer for the Department of Justice.

The Election Integrity Hotline allows voters who witness any
suspicious activity at their polling place, have issues with a voting
machine, or witness voter fraud or intimidation to send a detailed
email to Judicial Watch at ElectionLaw@JudicialWatch.org.

Our Judicial Watch election teams will monitor the election in
Wisconsin to expose and deter any fraud, and our Election Hotline will
expand our watchdog capability right down to the grass roots.

As you are probably aware, Judicial Watch is a national leader in
voting integrity and voting rights. As part of our work, we assembled
a team of highly experienced voting rights attorneys who stopped
discriminatory elections in Hawaii and cleaned up voter rolls across
the country among other achievements
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70840&L=21208&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdGFnL252cmEvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=6895639061ab0e9dd273a0f81e79d0c7c0d5d5fea1149f126ef741e00ac8c21d].

Robert Popper, a Judicial Watch senior attorney, leads its election
law program. Popper was previously in the Voting Section of the Civil
Rights Division of the Justice Department, where he managed voting
rights investigations, litigations, consent decrees, and settlements
in dozens of states.

The NVRA requires states to “conduct a general program that makes a
reasonable effort to remove” from the official voter rolls “the
names of ineligible voters” who have died or changed residence.
Among other things, the NVRA requires registrations to be cancelled
when voters fail to respond to address confirmation notices and then
fail to vote in the next two general federal elections. In 2018, the
Supreme Court confirmed that such removals are mandatory (_Husted v.

FBI officials about Trump’s tweets regarding them spying on him, as
well as their interaction with other media outlets including CNN.

Justice Department and CIA for communications between Ciaramella and
former FBI agent Peter Strzok, former FBI Attorney Lisa Page, former
FBI Deputy Director Andrew McCabe, and/or the Special Counsel’s
Office. In both cases the government refused to produce records,
“refusing to confirm or deny the existence or non-existence of
responsive records” because “confirming or denying the existence
or non-existence of responsive records would reveal information
protected by the CIA Act, namely the existence or non-existence of an
employment relationship between the Agency and Mr. Ciaramella.” And,
the government claimed, it would constitute an “unwarranted invasion
of personal privacy.”

The FBI, despite being a storied law enforcement agency, has an awful
record of corruption and cover-up. Judicial Watch’s litigation to
hold the FBI accountable under the law is – quite simply –
essential!

[INSIDE JW] Judicial Watch to Monitor Wisconsin Polls, Sets Up Election Fraud Report Hot Line [] With the election less than two weeks away, Judicial Watch is preparing to monitor Wisconsin polls and is setting up a National Election Fraud Report Line for voters to report voting issues as part of our ongoing election integrity efforts. Our trained observers will monitor polling sites in Wisconsin on November 5. Separately, Judicial Watch will run an Internet hotline [] for voters in all states to report suspicions of election and voter fraud. We monitor elections to ensure compliance with state and federal laws. Judicial Watch’s election observers have monitored many state and national elections and have been certified and served as international election observers. Our lead election law attorney, Robert Popper, established Judicial Watch’s election monitoring program. Popper is a former deputy chief of the Voting Section in the Civil Rights Division of the Department of Justice and a veteran poll observer for the Department of Justice. The Election Integrity Hotline allows voters who witness any suspicious activity at their polling place, have issues with a voting machine, or witness voter fraud or intimidation to send a detailed email to Judicial Watch at ElectionLaw@JudicialWatch.org. Our Judicial Watch election teams will monitor the election in Wisconsin to expose and deter any fraud, and our Election Hotline will expand our watchdog capability right down to the grass roots. As you are probably aware, Judicial Watch is a national leader in voting integrity and voting rights. As part of our work, we assembled a team of highly experienced voting rights attorneys who stopped discriminatory elections in Hawaii and cleaned up voter rolls across the country among other achievements []. Robert Popper, a Judicial Watch senior attorney, leads its election law program. Popper was previously in the Voting Section of the Civil Rights Division of the Justice Department, where he managed voting rights investigations, litigations, consent decrees, and settlements in dozens of states. The NVRA requires states to “conduct a general program that makes a reasonable effort to remove” from the official voter rolls “the names of ineligible voters” who have died or changed residence. Among other things, the NVRA requires registrations to be cancelled when voters fail to respond to address confirmation notices and then fail to vote in the next two general federal elections. In 2018, the Supreme Court confirmed that such removals are mandatory (Husted v. A. Philip Randolph Inst []., [] 138 S. Ct. 1833, 1841-42 (2018)). In September, we argued [] before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit regarding a lower court ruling on Mississippi’s election law that permits absentee ballots to be received as late as five business days after Election Day. In a similar lawsuit, in 2022, on behalf of Congressman Mike Bost and two other registered voters, we sued [] Illinois for allowing vote-by-mail ballots (even those without postmarks) to be counted if received up to 14 calendar days after Election Day if the ballots are dated on or before Election Day. We filed our latest California lawsuit in May 2024 after uncovering [] a broad failure to clean up voter rolls in dozens of California counties. We sued [] California under the NVRA to force it to clean up its voter rolls. The lawsuit, filed on behalf of Judicial Watch and the Libertarian Party of California, asks the court to compel California to make “a reasonable effort to remove the registrations of ineligible registrants from the voter rolls” as required by federal law. In February 2023, Los Angeles County confirmed [] removal of 1,207,613 ineligible voters from its rolls since the year before, under the terms of a settlement agreement [] in a federal lawsuit [] we filed in 2017. (Legal pressure from Judicial Watch ultimately led to the removal of up to four million ineligible voters [] from voter rolls in New York, California, Pennsylvania, Colorado, North Carolina, Kentucky, Ohio, and elsewhere.) In March 2024, on behalf of Breakthrough Ideas, Illinois Family Action, and Carol J. Davis, we sued [] Illinois officials under the NVRA to force them to clean the State’s voter rolls. In December 2023, our attorneys sent a notice letter [] to election officials in the District of Columbia notifying them of evident violations of the NVRA, based on their failure to remove inactive voters from their registration rolls. The letter pointed out that D.C. publicly reported removing few or no ineligible voter registrations under a key provision of the NVRA. The letter threatened a federal lawsuit unless the violations were corrected in a timely fashion. In response to Judicial Watch’s inquiries, Washington, D.C. officials admitted that they had not complied with the NVRA, promptly removed 65,544 outdated names from the voting rolls, promised to remove 37,962 more, and designated another 73,522 registrations as “inactive.” In July 2023 we filed [] an amicus curiae (friend of the court) brief [], supporting the decision [] of the U.S. District Court for the District of Maine, which struck down Maine’s policy restricting the use and distribution of the state’s voter registration list. According to a national study [] conducted by Judicial Watch in 2020, Maine’s statewide registration rate was 101% of eligible voters. In July 2023 we also settled [] a federal election integrity lawsuit on behalf of the Illinois Conservative Union against the state of Illinois, the Illinois State Board of Elections, and its director, which now grants access to the current centralized statewide list of registered voters for the state for the past 15 elections. In April 2023, Pennsylvania settled [] with us and admitted in court filings that it removed 178,258 ineligible registrations in response to communications from Judicial Watch. The settlement commits Pennsylvania and five of its counties to extensive public reporting of statistics regarding their ongoing voter roll clean-up efforts for the next five years. In March 2023, Colorado agreed [] to settle our NVRA lawsuit alleging that Colorado failed to remove ineligible voters from its rolls. The settlement agreement requires Colorado to provide Judicial Watch with the most recent voter roll data for each Colorado county each year for six years. We also settled [] a federal election integrity lawsuit against New York City after the city removed 441,083 ineligible names from the voter rolls and promised to take reasonable steps going forward to clean its voter registration lists. Kentucky [] also removed hundreds of thousands of old registrations after it entered into a consent decree to end another of our Judicial Watch lawsuits. In December 2023, our lawyers sent three other notice letters [] to election officials in the District of Columbia, California, and Illinois, notifying them of evident violations of the NVRA, based on their failure to remove inactive voters from their registration rolls. In response to Judicial Watch’s inquiries, Washington, D.C., officials admitted that they had not complied with the NVRA, promptly removed 65,544 outdated names from the voting rolls, promised to remove 37,962 more, and designated another 73,522 registrations as “inactive.” In July 2023 we filed [] an amicus curiae (friend of the court) brief [], supporting the decision [] of the U.S. District Court for the District of Maine, which struck down Maine’s policy restricting the use and distribution of the state’s voter registration list (Public Interest Legal Foundation v. Shenna Bellows [] (No. 23-1361). According to a national study [] we conducted in 2020, Maine’s statewide registration rate was 101% of eligible voters. In July 2023, we also settled [] a federal election integrity lawsuit on behalf of the Illinois Conservative Union against the state of Illinois, the Illinois State Board of Elections, and its director, which now grants access to the current centralized statewide list of registered voters for the state for the past 15 elections. In April 2023, Pennsylvania settled [] with us and admitted in court filings that it removed 178,258 ineligible registrations in response to communications from Judicial Watch. The settlement commits Pennsylvania and five of its counties to extensive public reporting of statistics regarding their ongoing voter roll clean-up efforts for the next five years. In March 2023, we filed a federal lawsuit [] against the Illinois State Board of Elections and its Executive Director, Bernadette Matthews, over their failure to clean Illinois’ voter rolls and to produce election-related records as required by federal law. Also in March 2023, Colorado agreed [] to settle a Judicial Watch NVRA lawsuit alleging that Colorado failed to remove ineligible voters from its rolls. The settlement agreement requires Colorado to provide us with the most recent voter roll data for each Colorado county each year for six years. In February 2022, we settled [] a voter roll clean-up lawsuit against North Carolina and two of its counties after North Carolina removed over 430,000 inactive registrations from its voter rolls. In March 2022, a Maryland court ruled in favor [] of Judicial Watch’s challenge to the Democratic state legislature’s “extreme” congressional-districts gerrymander. And, even after all this work, more is coming – as Judicial Watch increases its work to ensure free, fair, and honest elections! JUDICIAL WATCH SUES TO FORCE CLEAN UP OF OREGON VOTER ROLLS—LAWSUIT ALLEGES THE STATE HAS ONE OF WORST VOTING LISTS IN THE NATION Dirty voter rolls can mean dirty elections. Oregon has one of the dirtiest voting rolls in America and needs to clean them up ASAP! That’s why adding to our accomplishments listed above we filed our latest National Voter Registration Act (NVRA) lawsuit against the State of Oregon this week after uncovering [] a broad failure to clean up voter rolls in dozens of Oregon counties. In July 2024, our attorneys sent a notice letter [] to the Oregon secretary of state on behalf of itself, the Constitution Party of Oregon and an Oregon registered voter, notifying them of evident violations of the National Voter Registration Act [] (NVRA) of 1993, based on their failure to remove ineligible voters from their registration rolls. The letter to Oregon serves as a “pre-suit” notice. When Oregon claimed it was too expensive to comply with the mandates of the NVRA, we filed a lawsuit on behalf of the Constitution Party of Oregon and two lawfully registered voters of Umatilla County and Marion County, Oregon, against Lavonne Griffin-Valade in her official capacity as Oregon Secretary of State and the State of Oregon, to make “a reasonable effort to remove” the registrations of ineligible registrants from the voter rolls as required by federal law (Judicial Watch, et al. v. The State of Oregon et al. [] (No. 6:24-cv-01783)). The suit was filed to enforce basic voter list maintenance provisions under Section 8 of the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 (NVRA). In our complaint, our lawyers argue that Oregon’s voter rolls contain large numbers of old, inactive registrations; and that 29 of Oregon’s 36 counties removed few or no registrations as required by federal election law. Our complaint asserts that Oregon and 35 of its counties had overall registration rates exceeding 100%; and that Oregon has the highest known inactive registration rate of any state in the nation. In combination, all of these facts show that Oregon is failing to remove inactive registrations pursuant to Section 8(d)(1)(B) of the NVRA. The suit was filed in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Oregon, Eugene Division, to compel the defendants to comply with their voter list maintenance obligations under Section 8 of the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 (NVRA). We are being assisted in our Oregon lawsuit by Stephen Joncus of Joncus Law PC in Happy Valley, Oregon. Let’s hope Oregon does what it is supposed to do under law and start cleaning up its voting rolls! JUDICIAL WATCH SUES FOR RECORDS OF SOCIAL MEDIA POSTS CRITICAL OF DONALD TRUMP BY TOP FBI AGENT INVESTIGATING TRUMP ASSASSINATION ATTEMPT When we discovered [] top FBI officials allegedly ordered an agent to scrub his Facebook page to delete anti-Trump vitriol before they would promote him to head the bureau’s Miami field office, we launched a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request with the Justice Department to get to the bottom of this untoward effort to sanitize the bias of agents within the Bureau. The Biden-Harris FBI is engaged in a cover-up of a cover-up of one its top agent’s anti-Trump bias. This is why many Americans are concerned about the FBI’s dangerous political bias against Trump – and whether the FBI can be trusted to investigate the attempts on his life. We filed a FOIA lawsuit [] against the U.S. Department of Justice for messages among top leaders of the Federal Bureau of Investigation referencing social media posts of Special Agent Jeffrey Veltri [], head of the Miami Field Office, which is investigating the September 15 assassination attempt against Donald Trump (Judicial Watch v. U.S. Department of Justice [] (No. 1:24-cv-02740)). We sued after the Department of Justice refused to respond in full to a November 21, 2023, FOIA request for: 1. All emails and Lync system messages sent to and from the following 2. FBI officials referencing social media posts and/or Facebook posts generated by Miami Field Office Special Agent Jeffrey Veltri: Director Christopher Wray, Deputy Director Paul Abbate, and/or Executive Assistant Director Jennifer Moore. 3. All communications, whether by email, text message, or the FBI Lync system between Director Wray, Dep. Director Abbate and/or EAD Jennifer Moore on the one hand and Miami FO Special Agent Veltri related to Donald Trump, social media posts, Facebook and/or political opinions. Veltri was reportedly [] “one of several officials that used litmus tests to ‘purge’ political conservatives” like whistleblower Marcus Allen [] from the FBI. We have frequently sued the FBI when it refused to release requested documents. In June 2024 we released [] documents showing that the FBI Office of Congressional Affairs provided a Democrat staffer with information on FBI whistleblowers who detailed the bureau’s targeting of political opponents and retaliation for their testifying at a May 18, 2023, hearing of the House Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government. We also represented Marcus Allen, a decorated veteran, FBI analyst and witness [] before the Weaponization Subcommittee, in a lawsuit [] against FBI Director Christopher Wray for violating Allen’s constitutional rights by falsely accusing him of holding “conspiratorial views,” stripping his security clearance, and suspending him from duty without pay. On May 31, 2024, Allen’s security clearance was reinstated []. In January 2024, we filed a FOIA lawsuit [] against the U.S. Department of Defense for reports submitted by a military officer to his superiors regarding an alleged conversation around January 2017 between CIA analysts Eric Ciaramella and Sean Misko about trying to “get rid” of then-President Trump. In November 2023, we released [] FBI records showing top officials rushing to craft a public response to the leaked FBI intelligence memo that revealed its targeting of Catholics who adhere to traditional beliefs on church issues. In June 2023, we sued [] for all FBI communications from bureau officials using several systems and databases regarding investigations carried out after an October 4, 2021, memo from Attorney General Merrick Garland instructing investigators to target American parents due to an alleged “increase in harassment, intimidation and threats of violence against school board members, teachers and workers in our nation’s public schools” In a March 21, 2023, report [] on the Garland memo, the Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government cited FBI data which states that 25 inquiries under the threat tag “EDUOFFICIALS” had been opened since the bureau began tracking the alleged incidents. In September 2022, we filed a FOIA lawsuit [] for all records in the possession of FBI Supervisory Intelligence Analyst Brian Auten regarding an August 6, 2020, briefing provided to members of the U.S. Senate. Ron Johnson (R-WI) and Chuck Grassley (R-IA) that raised concerns that the briefing was intended to undermine the senators’ investigation of Hunter Biden. In May 2022, we announced a federal court ordered the FBI to disclose additional details about FBI and other officials “cc-ed” on the memo used to justify launching the “Crossfire Hurricane” spy operation against President Trump and his 2016 presidential campaign. Judge Carl J. Nichols had given the FBI until June 16, 2022, to respond. The order came in a September 2019 FOIA lawsuit [] our lawyers filed after the FBI failed to respond to a request for the memo, known as an “Electronic Communication” or “EC.” In August 2020, we released 323 pages [] of emails between former FBI official Peter Strzok and former FBI attorney Lisa Page. The records include an email from Strzok to other FBI officials about Trump’s tweets regarding them spying on him, as well as their interaction with other media outlets including CNN. In December 2019,we sued [] the Justice Department and CIA for communications between Ciaramella and former FBI agent Peter Strzok, former FBI Attorney Lisa Page, former FBI Deputy Director Andrew McCabe, and/or the Special Counsel’s Office. In both cases the government refused to produce records, “refusing to confirm or deny the existence or non-existence of responsive records” because “confirming or denying the existence or non-existence of responsive records would reveal information protected by the CIA Act, namely the existence or non-existence of an employment relationship between the Agency and Mr. Ciaramella.” And, the government claimed, it would constitute an “unwarranted invasion of personal privacy.” The FBI, despite being a storied law enforcement agency, has an awful record of corruption and cover-up. Judicial Watch’s litigation to hold the FBI accountable under the law is – quite simply – essential! JUDICIAL WATCH SUES FOR RECORDS ON KAMALA HARRIS SECRET SERVICE MOTORCADE ACCIDENT The Biden-Harris Secret Service is in a dangerous tailspin and literally can’t drive straight. And rather than be forthcoming about these issues with the American people, the Secret Service is engaged is a series of mounting and unlawful cover-ups, going back at least to a 2022 car accident by Kamala Harris’ Secret Service driver, which the agency initially – and falsely – dismissed as “mechanical failure.” We filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit [] against the U.S. Department of Homeland Security for records on a 2022 car accident involving Vice President Kamala Harris’s Secret Service motorcade (Judicial Watch, Inc. v. U.S. Department of Homeland Security [ (No. 1:24-cv-02752)). The suit was filed after the agency failed to respond to a July 19, 2024, our FOIA request for: 1. Any and all emails and text messages sent to and from members of the Vice-Presidential Protection Division regarding the October 3, 2022, accident involving the vehicle carrying Vice President Kamala Harris and/or the driving skills/abilities of the agent driving the vehicle at the time of the accident. 2. All waivers for defensive driver classes granted to USSS special agents involved in vehicular accidents with official vehicles. 3. Records reflecting directives for USSS special agents to undergo defensive driver classes as a result of being involved in accidents with official vehicles. The New York Post reported [] in October 2022 that “Vice President Kamala Harris was involved in a minor car accident Monday, one that was initially — and falsely — dismissed as ‘mechanical failure.’” The driver of her SUV struck a curb hard enough “that the tire needed to be replaced, bringing the VP’s motorcade to a standstill.” NBC reported [] that the vehicle had been partially airborne. In my new book, Rights and Freedoms in Peril [], I detail some of Judicial Watch’s numerous lawsuits and disclosures about Secret Service controversies. In addition, on September 3, 2024, following up on reports that the Biden Secret Service denied President Trump’s requests for additional Secret Service protection, we filed [] a FOIA lawsuit [] against the U.S. Department of Homeland Security for all Secret Service and other records regarding potential increased protective services to former President Trump’s security detail prior to the attempt on his life at his July 13 campaign rally in Butler, Pennsylvania (Judicial Watch v. U.S. Department of Homeland Security [ (No. 1:24-cv-02495)). On August 23, we received USSS records [] that show the Secret Service has made it a top priority that “diversity and inclusion is not just ‘talked about’ – but demonstrated by all employees through ‘EVERY ACTION, EVERY DAY.’” [Emphasis in original] The records show the Secret Service, demands that 12 percent of its workforce be composed of “persons with disabilities,” and that it is the policy of the Secret Service to provide equal employment opportunity without regard to such non-merit factors as “disability (physical or mental).” Until next week, [Contribute] [] [advertisement] [] [32x32x1] [] [32x32x2] [] [32x32x3] [] [32x32x3] [] Judicial Watch, Inc. 425 3rd St Sw Ste 800 Washington, DC 20024 202.646.5172 © 2017 - 2024, All Rights Reserved Manage Email Subscriptions [] |

* [**Michigan**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95835732/508034537/743835088?refcode=don_aotl_redite_email_StatesTexting_email_20241025-AOTL-RedLite-StatesTexting_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20241025-AOTL-RedLite-StatesTexting_&utm_campaign=StatesTexting&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImYzMzYyNDNiLTJkOTMtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=IMXjA9hjCfMO41aduWmelD3hcG-MYzZux0lb0nCzjJI=) voters passed a ballot initiative to create a fair redistricting process. name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: It's tightening
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
You deserve more than just a relentless stream of fundraising emails without a hint of substance
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2126%2E135344%2EULMrL7)

You deserve more than just a relentless stream of fundraising emails without a hint of substance, so I wanted to take a moment to send a message with a deeper look at the state of play here in Michigan with the hopes that treating you as more than just an ATM machine inspires you to donate to my campaign today. Okay, here goes:
When you start with the presidential race, one thing you can see over the past month is that things are tightening.
I am a bit of a numbers person, and from time to time I'll look at polling averages from people like Nate Silver (who’s actually a Michigander, by the way). And in his analysis you can see that the change over the past month, and the past week has been in Trump's favor.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241025-5-900&t=2&akid=2126%2E135344%2EULMrL7)
You can see that tightening is represented visually here as well.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241025-5-900&t=3&akid=2126%2E135344%2EULMrL7)
This is important for a number of reasons, not the least of which is something that you instinctively know -- which is whoever wins Michigan is likely to win the presidential election.
What about our race?
Public polling shows it's getting closer as well. If you look at the latest polls, two of the last three show our race a tie, with three polls this month showing that same result.
You can also see that in the Real Clear Politics polling averages. It's just gotten tighter over the past few weeks.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241025-5-900&t=4&akid=2126%2E135344%2EULMrL7)
So what does that mean for your support?
First, you know that we like to talk about our success with "losing better." That means doing better in the "red" parts of my district and the state than Democrats normally do.
One of the ways we do that is by turning out Democrats who don't always vote. That's good for me, of course – but it is also good for Kamala Harris.
But that work takes resources, and it means we are fundraising up right through the time the last ballot is cast.
So if you are looking for a place where your donation goes further than almost anywhere else right now, I hope this message has convinced you why my race is a good place to win.

clean_body: You deserve more than just a relentless stream of fundraising emails without a hint of substance You deserve more than just a relentless stream of fundraising emails without a hint of substance, so I wanted to take a moment to send a message with a deeper look at the state of play here in Michigan with the hopes that treating you as more than just an ATM machine inspires you to donate to my campaign today. Okay, here goes: When you start with the presidential race, one thing you can see over the past month is that things are tightening. I am a bit of a numbers person, and from time to time I'll look at polling averages from people like Nate Silver (who’s actually a Michigander, by the way). And in his analysis you can see that the change over the past month, and the past week has been in Trump's favor. You can see that tightening is represented visually here as well. This is important for a number of reasons, not the least of which is something that you instinctively know -- which is whoever wins Michigan is likely to win the presidential election. What about our race? Public polling shows it's getting closer as well. If you look at the latest polls, two of the last three show our race a tie, with three polls this month showing that same result. You can also see that in the Real Clear Politics polling averages. It's just gotten tighter over the past few weeks. So what does that mean for your support? First, you know that we like to talk about our success with "losing better." That means doing better in the "red" parts of my district and the state than Democrats normally do. One of the ways we do that is by turning out Democrats who don't always vote. That's good for me, of course – but it is also good for Kamala Harris. But that work takes resources, and it means we are fundraising up right through the time the last ballot is cast. So if you are looking for a place where your donation goes further than almost anywhere else right now, I hope this message has convinced you why my race is a good place to win. body:

Friend --

Senator Ted Cruz here.
Desperate times call for desperate measures, and I'm afraid **we're in some desperate times.**
[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHn/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg2OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg2OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
_Texas is in danger of flipping blue for the first time in generations!_

We are in danger of losing the great state of Texas...

_**If that happens, even if President Trump wins the election, he won't be able to push his agenda through Congress...**_
_****_
_**And if we lose Texas as a Republican stronghold, regardless of who wins in 2024, we might never had another Republican President again...**_

| | [KEEP TEXAS RED](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHn/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg2OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg2OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
Today, I am reaching out to you, about an _**extremely important issue...**_****

Not on my own behalf, but on behalf of a good friend of mine,**Brandon Gill** , who is running for Congress to represent __**YOU**__ _****_****in D.C., and help**me** in stopping the Left from taking control of the Lone Star State.

Brandon Gill is a proud husband, a proud father, a long-time **supporter** and **fighter** for President Trump, and a _**warrior**_****for our Conservative causes!

[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHn/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg2OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg2OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
_My friend, Brandon Gill, and his wife._
Brandon Gill has **my personal endorsement**... He has **President Trump's personal endorsement**...
_**[And now, I'm asking for YOU to join me and join President Trump in supporting Brandon Gill's fight to KEEP TEXAS RED, and HELP SAVE AMERICA](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHn/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg2OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg2OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**_**[!!](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHo/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg2OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg2OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**

I've been in Congress for a while now-- I know what it means to fight against the left, to face their relentless attacks, **and _I know what it takes to win..._**
I can tell you, _without a shadow of a doubt_ , _**Brandon Gill is a killer who will take the fight to them, and _never back down_.**_
Listen-- Politicians come and go, and believe me, I know how it feels to be disappointed by people who campaign on _one thing_ , and then once they get to D.C., _they do another_...
_**But there is not a doubt in my mind about Brandon Gill...**_
_**HE WILL NOT LET YOU DOWN!**_
[JOIN TED CRUZ & PRESIDENT TRUMP IN SUPPORTING BRANDON GILL](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHn/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg2OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg2OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Believe me, _**keeping Texas red might be one of the most consequential fights the Republican Party will face for decades to come.**_
_**We can't afford to let a Democrat take TX-26:
WE NEED BRANDON GILL!**_

There is so much to do...
**We must secure our Southern Border!**
Brandon Gill and I have talked about how we've seen Texas transform as its become infested with illegals, and _**he is ready to fight for deportation!**_
**We must defend the 1st Amendment!**
Brandon Gill is ready to join me in Congress and take the fight to the _bureaucrats_ , and _tyrants_ who think they can _**curtail your God-given rights!**_
**We must protect women's bathrooms, locker rooms, and sports!**
Brandon Gill is a proud husband and father to a beautiful daughter, and I know _**he won't put up with men invading women's spaces!**_
**We must secure our elections, and DEMAND Voter ID nationwide!**
Brandon Gill knows how important this issue is, and I know _**he will never back down on keeping illegals OFF our voter rolls, and OUT of our voting booths.**_
**We need the largest deportation force in the history of the world!**
I know Brandon Gill is especially passionate about this issue... _**And I can't wait to see him fight alongside me and President Trump _to get it done_.**_
[JOIN TED CRUZ & PRESIDENT TRUMP IN SUPPORTING BRANDON GILL](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHn/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg2OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg2OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
If these are **ideas you can get behind...**
If you think Congress needs a family man, a member of the younger generation, who will _**bring the fight to Capitol Hill...**_
If you know _(like I do)_ that _**keeping Texas red**_ is one of the most important fights of this election...
**_[Then join the fight, and help me get Brandon Gill to Congress to help me fight, to support President Trump,a nd to stop the violent and radical left!](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHn/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg2OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg2OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_**
When President Trump and I come together to endorse a candidate, I know you know-- _**That's a candidate that's going to go far!**_
If we don't get Brandon Gill across the finishing line, _**Texas will be in a _very, very bad position and 2024 and beyond..._**_
_**_[It's all hands on deck... We need YOU NOW! ARE YOU WITH ME?](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHn/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg2OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg2OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_**_

I wouldn't be asking if it wasn't serious... But when President Trump and I both rally behind a candidate, you can bet _**that's a candidate that deserves your support!**_

Texas is in danger of flipping blue for the first time in generations! We are in danger of losing the great state of Texas... If that happens, even if President Trump wins the election, he won't be able to push his agenda through Congress... ** And if we lose Texas as a Republican stronghold, regardless of who wins in 2024, we might never had another Republican President again... | | Today, I am reaching out to you, about an extremely important issue... Brandon Gill is a proud husband, a proud father, a long-time supporter and fighter for President Trump, and a warriorfor our Conservative causes! My friend, Brandon Gill, and his wife. Brandon Gill has my personal endorsement... He has President Trump's personal endorsement... I've been in Congress for a while now-- I know what it means to fight against the left, to face their relentless attacks, and I know what it takes to win... I can tell you, without a shadow of a doubt , Brandon Gill is a killer who will take the fight to them, and never back down. Listen-- Politicians come and go, and believe me, I know how it feels to be disappointed by people who campaign on one thing , and then once they get to D.C., they do another... But there is not a doubt in my mind about Brandon Gill... HE WILL NOT LET YOU DOWN! Believe me, keeping Texas red might be one of the most consequential fights the Republican Party will face for decades to come. We can't afford to let a Democrat take TX-26: WE NEED BRANDON GILL! There is so much to do... We must secure our Southern Border! Brandon Gill and I have talked about how we've seen Texas transform as its become infested with illegals, and he is ready to fight for deportation! We must defend the 1st Amendment! Brandon Gill is ready to join me in Congress and take the fight to the bureaucrats , and tyrants who think they can curtail your God-given rights! We must protect women's bathrooms, locker rooms, and sports! Brandon Gill is a proud husband and father to a beautiful daughter, and I know he won't put up with men invading women's spaces! We must secure our elections, and DEMAND Voter ID nationwide! Brandon Gill knows how important this issue is, and I know he will never back down on keeping illegals OFF our voter rolls, and OUT of our voting booths. We need the largest deportation force in the history of the world! I know Brandon Gill is especially passionate about this issue... And I can't wait to see him fight alongside me and President Trump to get it done. If these are ideas you can get behind... If you think Congress needs a family man, a member of the younger generation, who will bring the fight to Capitol Hill... If you know (like I do) that keeping Texas red is one of the most important fights of this election... name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: they’re plotting something sinister
body:
Dear Peter,

The election is in less than two weeks . . .

If Democrats seize control of the U.S. Senate, House, and White House in November they won’t stop short of destroying America just so they can kill more babies.

And they aren’t hiding it either.

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/0UpCU7z3LjRDsXeIandDlw~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo__HGfOHUdjUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~

Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer (D-NY) has boasted about their plot to pack the Supreme Court with up to SIX pro-abortion justices and impose a “code of ethics” – which would force the Supreme Court to only rule in the Abortion Lobby’s favor.

Senator Elizabeth Warren (D-MA) has also promised they WILL eliminate the U.S. Senate’s filibuster the MOMENT they seize total control of Washington, D.C.

Former House Speaker Nancy Pelosi (D-CA) even went on national TV to threaten:

“We can enshrine into the law Roe v. Wade. We can overturn the 60-vote rule... the filibuster, and pass it [Roe] with a 51-vote margin.”

And Vice President Kamala Harris has supported all of it . . . and WORSE.

If elected, her first act as President will be to RAM pro-abortion legislation far worse than Roe v. Wade into law that would force all 50 states to allow abortion-on-demand up until (and even after) birth – and force taxpayers to fund it all!

Peter, if Kamala and her pro-abortion pals get their wish on November 5th, more precious preborn babies than ever will pay the ultimate price.

That’s why you and I must do all we can to stop them BEFORE it’s too late.

Will you please urgently make a generous contribution toward Students for Life Action’s critical Election Year Programs
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/KVZKhKe6o7A3N-qYFUgAsw~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo__HGfOHUdjUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~
?

All the Abortion Lobby has to do to make this NIGHTMARE a reality is to:

*** Install Kamala Harris in the White House;

*** Maintain their control of the U.S. Senate; and

*** Pick up just five seats in the U.S. House.

That’s it . . .

The only way pro-lifers can stop them is if we outpace them and get out the pro-life vote – specifically in 10 key Battleground and Referendum States.

The good news is, Students for Life Action is doing that even as I send you this email through our 2024 Election Year Programs, including:

• DOOR-TO-DOOR CANVASSING DEPLOYMENTS;

• OUR “VOTE PRO-LIFE FIRST” DIGITAL CAMPAIGN;

• CAMPUS AND CHURCH OUTREACH;

• EARLY VOTER AND VOTER REGISTRATION EVENTS;

• TEXTING CAMPAIGNS;

• NATIONAL AD RUNS ON FOX NEWS; AND

• EVEN MORE AS WE APPROACH THE ELECTION!

As the ONLY national pro-life organization targeting young voters, keeping these programs running at FULL BLAST is going to be critical to stopping the Abortion Lobby in their tracks.

But “FULL BLAST” only gets tougher the closer we get to Election Day . . .

With everything on the line in 2024, I’ll need the full support of good folks like you Peter, if we want to have any chance of winning this fight.

So, please consider making a generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or $25 toward Students for Life Action’s critical Election Year Programs right away
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/0HZj-Lp4s88Zvn4GTK-IIQ~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo__HGfOHUdjUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~
!

Even chipping in just $10 will help create a grassroots “snowball” effect from pro-lifers across the country
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/fuZ3HUchqadNV2pb8tQiCg~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo__HGfOHUdjUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~
.

Thank you for your support and for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

P.S. – Should the Abortion Lobby succeed at installing Kamala Harris in the Oval Office, seizing back control of the U.S. House, and holding onto even a slim Senate Majority, there could be no stopping their radical agenda, including:

1. PACKING THE U.S. SUPREME COURT;

2. DESTROYING THE U.S. SENATE FILIBUSTER; AND

3. RAMMING PRO-ABORTION LEGISLATION FAR WORSE THAN ROE v. WADE INTO LAW.

Students for Life Action is the ONLY National Pro-Life organization targeting young voters – so our Election Year Programs are going to be critical to stopping the Abortion Lobby’s plot!

And Peter, your full support is critical to the success of our programs!

Will you please consider making your most generous contribution toward Students for Life Action to help boost our efforts before November 5th

Hey friend. Bradley Whitford here.

You might know me as Josh Lyman from _The West Wing_ , but what we’re facing today is far from fiction.

**Voting rights, reproductive freedoms, and the very foundation of our democracy are all on the ballot this November.**

And with just 11 days left until Election Day, we all need to do our parts to fight for the future we deserve.

That’s why I’m proud to partner with the Democratic Party of Wisconsin and DASS PAC as they work to boost voter turnout and elect Democrats up and down the ballot.

| |

| | | Friend,

There is not much time left to save this country. I'm willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left.

**[Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=633d45d17bf047d986d30f1d03b5506a&_e=cp3_H2ymfcEK0Jit_V_r9WgCxSHpUwt4sauMbPaOWTWH7V0684ikN8DKEsLVAjncBwcRIvPkX02C94jUF0R8Ixv9K_NGfYwDNubJIO6PPB_t06kQikiMQm55_53zDgQtkUO1VDv30uDfKQlrDUavBpAkwqS_Rw7zBwNFGeY0XflnOF0QrlFT1hitc5ButxRouifTSbOutIn2dtXEp9SfDi07FfKttr-Om5VBMaZcGSTtWhV7etOxbEbj8L1Kf5833CdADOeCzgkAbem6-nby7cvna1CzwplkrUbQFfNX4W04M7bWH6iKAoPydqq2j_Rhtfe5C-sTYY_2Dwt-klKIyZ7q5vx8A0wADiR8QEioxdcz8s8zEEnFYqDd69W7WHghCyP7XKqsUcMGFOtPY2DvLNtWwYmg7OxIiFM_o4JlM-R9jFbfPsR9aVok5YR6OoGn "Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?")**

Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I am just a normal mom. The disgusting things the media and establishment have done to me are unforgivable. If you had asked me a few years ago if I believed someone would come to my door and ask me to sell out my country for a pile of cash, I wouldn't have believed you.

**There 's so much I miss about my life before politics, and there's no shortage of sacrifices I've had to make. Much of them at the cost of my personal life. **

I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media.

**I miss my family.** There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to.

**I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing.** Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out.

**I miss not having to send these emails.** Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, even if it hurts my pride to ask you for help.

**I miss my alone time!** I never realized how much I took advantage of spending a few hours by myself. In this race, I'm often campaigning from dawn to dusk and, more often than not, early into the morning of the next day.

Friend, as much as I miss some of the comforts of day-to-day life, I know the sacrifices I'm making now will be worth it.

Now listen, there are less than two months before ballots start dropping in Arizona, and I need your help now more than ever. Recent polls show me tied to my opponent, Ruben Gallego, and every penny could push us over the edge and help secure victory.

Today, I'm asking you to make a sacrifice Friend. Will you stand with me and make a ONE TIME small-dollar contribution to my Senate campaign?

**New polling shows that I've plummeted an alarming __7 POINTS__ since September.** That means my Trump-obsessed, anti-abortion opponent has _all_ of the momentum with less than two weeks to go before Election Day – and we hardly have any time left to turn this around.
**That's why I'm calling for all hands on deck at this make-or-break moment: ****[Will you rush $5 or more right now to help me reach my $250,000 emergency goal so I can fight back against the GOP, pull ahead, and win in Nevada?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95837875/508075350/-1820320010?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk5198-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MzI3NmE4NS0zYTkzLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dJymPCdIpEC_lM11lGjTLFg8MvRaWPi2ppcprl0sHKk=)**

After _The Cook Political Report_ called Nevada the "most perilous" battleground for Democrats, we already knew this race was going to come down to the margins – especially with experts predicting it would decide both Senate control and the White House.

subject: I've made a lot of sacrifices.

| | | Friend,

There is not much time left to save this country. I'm willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left.

**[Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=fff7609d822a4812b323df8299572c47&_e=ez6DjWgRDcFPiPsLGLV2f5evQ08dC8441buSN3Jf3vXON9EzuaxAg9CWiHiA0wB-XwOtB79LzVR-_X8F7idTmm0w0tpoTfo7OSeqq5XU0srcoPqp9G2Yk1nCMa0f-oib9aTv8d-Eyi8ra2xNdizCGqb4LhKfUrc4iX1eCoe7O1jIDvMlyPCmfzjYxOIox6lYiHuzKTFH7QGl1qNiTtsThp8Ww9CYpXfOdsgXgn06epcv8ODkehSNiS1v-OtIW8R7TKKeSbSuPWPDUD5FnE6tsgF55VLJxaI9hBzzmejwu3pB_Nrtu9t4iOt8SLWJT23sv7jw626lHv3lZXsO2wgtYZBumuP58UlLUT9cyymyXwNkvR4pUGIb4cBkbI-AtlQDmbigYMegUzbWMbjQZ62YUhTmMQgvsg6JsLevxp5oZsWIUqoSDI7YDNVoah-Kt9WW "Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?")**

Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I am just a normal mom. The disgusting things the media and establishment have done to me are unforgivable. If you had asked me a few years ago if I believed someone would come to my door and ask me to sell out my country for a pile of cash, I wouldn't have believed you.

**There 's so much I miss about my life before politics, and there's no shortage of sacrifices I've had to make. Much of them at the cost of my personal life. **

I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media.

**I miss my family.** There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to.

**I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing.** Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out.

**I miss not having to send these emails.** Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, even if it hurts my pride to ask you for help.

**I miss my alone time!** I never realized how much I took advantage of spending a few hours by myself. In this race, I'm often campaigning from dawn to dusk and, more often than not, early into the morning of the next day.

Friend, as much as I miss some of the comforts of day-to-day life, I know the sacrifices I'm making now will be worth it.

Now listen, there are less than two months before ballots start dropping in Arizona, and I need your help now more than ever. Recent polls show me tied to my opponent, Ruben Gallego, and every penny could push us over the edge and help secure victory.

Today, I'm asking you to make a sacrifice Friend. Will you stand with me and make a ONE TIME small-dollar contribution to my Senate campaign?

I’m willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left. | | | | | Friend, There is not much time left to save this country. I'm willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left. "Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?" Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I am just a normal mom. The disgusting things the media and establishment have done to me are unforgivable. If you had asked me a few years ago if I believed someone would come to my door and ask me to sell out my country for a pile of cash, I wouldn't have believed you. There 's so much I miss about my life before politics, and there's no shortage of sacrifices I've had to make. Much of them at the cost of my personal life. I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media. I miss my family. There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to. I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing. Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out. I miss not having to send these emails. Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, even if it hurts my pride to ask you for help. I miss my alone time! I never realized how much I took advantage of spending a few hours by myself. In this race, I'm often campaigning from dawn to dusk and, more often than not, early into the morning of the next day. Friend, as much as I miss some of the comforts of day-to-day life, I know the sacrifices I'm making now will be worth it. Now listen, there are less than two months before ballots start dropping in Arizona, and I need your help now more than ever. Recent polls show me tied to my opponent, Ruben Gallego, and every penny could push us over the edge and help secure victory. Today, I'm asking you to make a sacrifice Friend. ### Be out in the community for Tad
Wear your Jude shirts!

_SATURDAY 10/26:_
*Door Knocking in Coon Rapids
*"Spooktacular Carnival"
*Anoka "Grand Day Parade"

SUNDAY 10/27:
*Bloomington Citywide Trick or Treating
*Edinborough Entertainment Series

---
****SATURDAY 10/26:****
**1) Door-knocking in Coon Rapids**
Time: 10am-2pm
Location: meet at **Anoka County Library** , Crooked Lake Blvd
NOTE: Volunteers may help with either door knocking or lit drop

**2) "Spooktacular Carnival" **
Time: 10am-1pm
Location: **Anoka Middle School** , 1523 S 5th Ave, Anoka
NOTE: Volunteers may show up anytime, or plan to walk around with Tad from 12-1:00pm.

**3) Anoka "Grand Day PARADE"**
Time: 1-3:00pm
Location: **Meet at 1pm in parking lot of St. Stephens's Church**
** 525 Jackson St, Anoka**
NOTE: Volunteers can walk around the sidewalk crowds with Jude shirts, and hand out Jude stickers.
The parade starts at 1 pm at the corner of State Street and West Main Street. Route follows Main Street to 5th Avenue and finishes at South Street/ Military Road. The parade length is 1.5 miles long.
**
SUNDAY 10/27:**
**1) Bloomington Citywide Trick or Treating**
Time: 2-5:00pm
Location: **Normandale Lake Park** , 84th Street and Chalet Road, Bloomington
NOTE: Volunteers may show up anytime, or walk around with Tad 2-3:30pm.

**2) Edinborough Entertainment Series**
Time: 6-7:00pm
Location: **Edinborough Park** , 7700 York Ave S, Edina

name: Larry Klayman
subject: Urgent Update: Cruel Jail Guards Torture Patriots
body:
I quote directly from their letter, published by Gateway Pundit. Guards deny them hot water, and keep them from going to court. They severely beat, mace, harass, insult, and even sexually assault them.

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zj81hqlkjarp4u9b505bi45r4skqf7la4058a7ko_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4sjj6ao36cph2bs)
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z73e9jg5gi0u8ok3gbmu84sd5ft8a998ufpjdt6g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4sjj6ao36cph2bs) Dear Patriot,

**[Please give a crucial $25, $50, $100, or more now to help free January 6 peaceful protesters!](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zjranlnklhvjl6td7mcp0lj7s3nog1pat4oq4qo0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4sjj6ao36cph2bs)**

Over a year and a half ago, I wrote an urgent email to patriots just like you about what's really happening to January 6 peaceful protesters in the Washington, DC jail.

I wish I could tell you that Republican Congressmen investigated those horror stories ... brought the vicious guards to justice ... and had our fellow patriots transferred out of there.

But that's not the case.

**Patriot, what 's being done to January 6 peaceful protesters is so demonic, so foul, that they BEGGED to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba...where vicious, America-hating terrorists get better treatment!**

I'm heartsick and deeply angry about what's being done to our fellow patriots.

Please allow me to share their gut-wrenching cry for help with you.

Here's what they're suffering (I quote directly from their letter, published by Gateway Pundit):

* **Begging for Help / Water / Medical Aid / Mercy****through a 4 inch by 10 inch window of cold metal doors**
* No visits from family, friends, lawyers, or clergy
* No Mass or Sunday worship service
* Laundry returning with brown stains, pubic hair, and or reeking of urine
* Broken toilets that either wont flush or repeatedly explode in Cells
* Stuck in Cells for 9 days without shower
* Solitary Confinement for 25 1⁄2 hours or more at a time

But there's more.

**Guards deny them hot water, and keep them from going to court. They severely beat, mace, harass, insult, and even sexually assault them.**

Their food is so disgusting and so low in nutrition, that some prisoners are losing their eyesight, their hair, and getting scurvy (from Vitamin C deficiency).

There's much, much more...all of it horrifying.

And this has been going on for years ... in AMERICA.

**They end their heartbreaking letter by BEGGING to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba, where Taliban and Islamic terrorists who 've killed US troops get better treatment.**

But there's something you can do about it.

I'm Larry Klayman, founder and general counsel for Freedom Watch.

I'm a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who's fought for the American people for 47 years.

You've probably seen me on cable news or heard me on talk radio.

**I 'm the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President had committed a crime. I _guarantee_ Bill Clinton still remembers me!**

And I successfully represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents, and win. And my critical new lawsuit is a game changer.

**Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice BROKE THE LAW and ILLEGALLY SPIED ON LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS ... and I can PROVE it in court! That means their criminal convictions can be THROWN OUT. And their criminal trials can be THROWN OUT.**

And I'm taking other hard-hitting legal actions to protect our fellow Americans and our endangered rights and freedoms.

Let me tell you, no other legal group in the country is doing what Freedom Watch is doing to defend and free January 6 patriots.

You see, many defense lawyers are scared spitless of the FBI and DOJ. So they tell their clients to plead guilty to crimes they didn't commit ... and they end up in prison.

But Freedom Watch fights!

Patriot, please say a pray for the January 6 prisoners. Their temptation to give up must be enormous.

**[Then I beg you to help me fight for them in court with your critically important gift of $25, $50, $100, or even more immediately.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zaq5f63mtlh14qkvjcr5e0i49egjdpj6mjgeg1o8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4sjj6ao36cph2bs)**

I can't do it without you.

Thank you for doing whatever you can **now**.

In Justice,

Larry Klayman
Founder, Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Chairman and General Counsel, Freedom Watch, Inc.

**P.S. Patriot, innocent Americans are begging for water in the Washington, DC jail.** These innocent men and women are being tortured and abused like they were political prisoners in a Third World dictatorship!

**[Please give what you can right now to help me fight to set them free. $25, $50, $100, even more...whatever you can spare at this very moment. Every dollar counts. And the clock is ticking.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2ztcff893d84q1026gui6c7mgn1qflbqs3tk9oac8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4sjj6ao36cph2bs)**

| | Dear Friend,

I'm thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

Perhaps you've wondered where the artwork accompanying the lectures in our free online courses comes from. We hear this especially for one of our most popular courses, "The Genesis Story."

The Book of Genesis has inspired some of Western Civilization's greatest artists to produce iconic works. You may be familiar with Michelangelo's "The Creation of Adam" and Rembrandt's "The Sacrifice of Issac."

I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel...

[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zum9pstlaadss2kj9jn8er9qmpdnp4i01odgg800_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4sjj6ao36c9h2bs) **We 've compiled these paintings, along with many others featured in this course, into a brand-new coffee table book, "The Genesis Story: Course Companion." And I'd like you to receive a copy.**

With this exclusive book--available only from Hillsdale College--you can read the passages from the Book of Genesis that led Michelangelo, Rembrandt, Gustave Dore, and other masters to create these incredible works of art.

And with these works all in one place, you and your family can enjoy page after page of divinely inspired art.

**You can reserve your copy of "The Genesis Story: Course Companion," an exclusive hard-cover book from Hillsdale College, for a generous donation of $100 or more by clicking the secure link below: **

Thanks again for your continued support and generosity. I hope you'll enjoy this beautiful book.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01

Hillsdale College

| | Dear Friend,

I'm thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

Perhaps you've wondered where the artwork accompanying the lectures in our free online courses comes from. We hear this especially for one of our most popular courses, "The Genesis Story."

The Book of Genesis has inspired some of Western Civilization's greatest artists to produce iconic works. You may be familiar with Michelangelo's "The Creation of Adam" and Rembrandt's "The Sacrifice of Issac."

I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel...

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z82qp7t03mg53e16dd4ce5vq7c5u6grk7rhmlrro_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4sjj6ap74cth2bs) **We 've compiled these paintings, along with many others featured in this course, into a brand-new coffee table book, "The Genesis Story: Course Companion." With this exclusive book--available only from Hillsdale College--you can read the passages from the Book of Genesis that led Michelangelo, Rembrandt, Gustave Dore, and other masters to create these incredible works of art.

And with these works all in one place, you and your family can enjoy page after page of divinely inspired art.

**You can reserve your copy of "The Genesis Story: Course Companion," an exclusive hard-cover book from Hillsdale College, for a generous donation of $100 or more by clicking the secure link below: **

You may be familiar with Michelangelo's "The Creation of Adam" and Rembrandt's "The Sacrifice of Issac." I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel... We 've compiled these paintings, along with many others featured in this course, into a brand-new coffee table book, "The Genesis Story: Course Companion." And I'd like you to receive a copy. With this exclusive book--available only from Hillsdale College--you can read the passages from the Book of Genesis that led Michelangelo, Rembrandt, Gustave Dore, and other masters to create these incredible works of art. And with these works all in one place, you and your family can enjoy page after page of divinely inspired art. You can reserve your copy of "The Genesis Story: Course Companion," an exclusive hard-cover book from Hillsdale College, for a generous donation of $100 or more by clicking the secure link below: Thanks again for your continued support and generosity. I hope you'll enjoy this beautiful book. Warm regards, Bill Gray, '01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College | | American Action News PO Box 1177 Fort Collins, CO 80522 |

subject: You can own a piece of art history
body:
I’m thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/MY03eNuISIuBSeiMW7yTxg~~/AARclAA~/RgRo_zeSP0S_~)
---
---
| | Dear Friend,

I'm thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

Perhaps you've wondered where the artwork accompanying the lectures in our free online courses comes from. We hear this especially for one of our most popular courses, "The Genesis Story."

The Book of Genesis has inspired some of Western Civilization's greatest artists to produce iconic works. You may be familiar with Michelangelo's "The Creation of Adam" and Rembrandt's "The Sacrifice of Issac."

I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel...

[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/MY03eNuISIuBSeiMW7yTxg~~/AARclAA~/RgRo_zeSP0S_~) **We 've compiled these paintings, along with many others featured in this course, into a brand-new coffee table book, "The Genesis Story: Course Companion." And I'd like you to receive a copy.**

With this exclusive book--available only from Hillsdale College--you can read the passages from the Book of Genesis that led Michelangelo, Rembrandt, Gustave Dore, and other masters to create these incredible works of art.

And with these works all in one place, you and your family can enjoy page after page of divinely inspired art.

**You can reserve your copy of "The Genesis Story: Course Companion," an exclusive hard-cover book from Hillsdale College, for a generous donation of $100 or more by clicking the secure link below: **

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/genesis-story-course-companion-book](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/MY03eNuISIuBSeiMW7yTxg~~/AARclAA~/RgRo_zeSP0S_~)**

Thanks again for your continued support and generosity. I hope you'll enjoy this beautiful book.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

**[Please give a crucial $25, $50, $100, or more now to help free January 6 peaceful protesters!](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=17b4152dd10c4a98a2a0717d3f845f13&_e=LEtxosVclQ6Oec6nPFqim9WUoBnrtxYH5Mx3focqlrQ9A8sxsxi-VAjDZbWWPDxAf6Letkg_2mDmgge9UoivmFhqDFL-DHoAck3_VScG1xGE0IK6qln7hIAEbw0HOptBAUt2d1t3-U5hwMlZFkxNly0ChRTG2fAhySvyFKVAW8pCrf3VaUncpYe9HHYjhzqgNA2a15xigvkBykg9JkEj-1IUWAbzpQCMwz4aDLQvFPs-D5Dt2GAYhP16XKU2uKJbb7VQvRMC5GzxoI1opp_K2uC1aD-iJR2FsSc3gq7PgVzbKfUp-ONxtjPCIPyKXA7JDs57RkybnylWh0Iu-gsEqbc0DGLpM2KuC1W-9uxmtSA%3D)**

Over a year and a half ago, I wrote an urgent email to patriots just like you about what's really happening to January 6 peaceful protesters in the Washington, DC jail.

I wish I could tell you that Republican Congressmen investigated those horror stories ... brought the vicious guards to justice ... and had our fellow patriots transferred out of there.

But that's not the case.

**Patriot, what 's being done to January 6 peaceful protesters is so demonic, so foul, that they BEGGED to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba...where vicious, America-hating terrorists get better treatment!**

I'm heartsick and deeply angry about what's being done to our fellow patriots.

Please allow me to share their gut-wrenching cry for help with you.

Here's what they're suffering (I quote directly from their letter, published by Gateway Pundit):

* **Begging for Help / Water / Medical Aid / Mercy****through a 4 inch by 10 inch window of cold metal doors**
* No visits from family, friends, lawyers, or clergy
* No Mass or Sunday worship service
* Laundry returning with brown stains, pubic hair, and or reeking of urine
* Broken toilets that either wont flush or repeatedly explode in Cells
* Stuck in Cells for 9 days without shower
* Solitary Confinement for 25 1⁄2 hours or more at a time

But there's more.

**Guards deny them hot water, and keep them from going to court. They severely beat, mace, harass, insult, and even sexually assault them.**

Their food is so disgusting and so low in nutrition, that some prisoners are losing their eyesight, their hair, and getting scurvy (from Vitamin C deficiency).

There's much, much more...all of it horrifying.

And this has been going on for years ... in AMERICA.

**They end their heartbreaking letter by BEGGING to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba, where Taliban and Islamic terrorists who 've killed US troops get better treatment.**

But there's something you can do about it.

I'm Larry Klayman, founder and general counsel for Freedom Watch.

I'm a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who's fought for the American people for 47 years.

You've probably seen me on cable news or heard me on talk radio.

**I 'm the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President had committed a crime. I _guarantee_ Bill Clinton still remembers me!**

And I successfully represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents, and win. And my critical new lawsuit is a game changer.

**Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice BROKE THE LAW and ILLEGALLY SPIED ON LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS ... and I can PROVE it in court! That means their criminal convictions can be THROWN OUT. And their criminal trials can be THROWN OUT.**

And I'm taking other hard-hitting legal actions to protect our fellow Americans and our endangered rights and freedoms.

Let me tell you, no other legal group in the country is doing what Freedom Watch is doing to defend and free January 6 patriots.

You see, many defense lawyers are scared spitless of the FBI and DOJ. So they tell their clients to plead guilty to crimes they didn't commit ... and they end up in prison.

But Freedom Watch fights!

Patriot, please say a pray for the January 6 prisoners. Their temptation to give up must be enormous.

**[Then I beg you to help me fight for them in court with your critically important gift of $25, $50, $100, or even more immediately.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=17b4152dd10c4a98a2a0717d3f845f13&_e=LEtxosVclQ6Oec6nPFqim9WUoBnrtxYH5Mx3focqlrQ9A8sxsxi-VAjDZbWWPDxAf6Letkg_2mDmgge9UoivmFhqDFL-DHoAck3_VScG1xGE0IK6qln7hIAEbw0HOptBAUt2d1t3-U5hwMlZFkxNly0ChRTG2fAhySvyFKVAW8pCrf3VaUncpYe9HHYjhzqgJ1OCYdBzd2zMWUSrBfUf00CShy63KCtz23szecP3TLzVyf7G8Z9AagPT5_dihtsnsezeUEMkAf5t3TFKByLPrR-cfvaHLjFfOQMYhGJbzLf4A7RRXCYG0QtSgvV2B7N1e14hnf3dy-BWaAxiV1FhgzuGmIFd_G81YV71BxuXPxA%3D)**

I can't do it without you.

Thank you for doing whatever you can **now**.

In Justice,

Larry Klayman
Founder, Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Chairman and General Counsel, Freedom Watch, Inc.

**P.S. Patriot, innocent Americans are begging for water in the Washington, DC jail.** These innocent men and women are being tortured and abused like they were political prisoners in a Third World dictatorship!

**[Please give what you can right now to help me fight to set them free. $25, $50, $100, even more...whatever you can spare at this very moment. Every dollar counts. And the clock is ticking.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=17b4152dd10c4a98a2a0717d3f845f13&_e=LEtxosVclQ6Oec6nPFqim9WUoBnrtxYH5Mx3focqlrQ9A8sxsxi-VAjDZbWWPDxAf6Letkg_2mDmgge9UoivmFhqDFL-DHoAck3_VScG1xGE0IK6qln7hIAEbw0HOptBAUt2d1t3-U5hwMlZFkxNly0ChRTG2fAhySvyFKVAW8pCrf3VaUncpYe9HHYjhzqg6m1GYeUTABhVaBTi5n7wjfvVDyq_NLoLxD8YLARk-cjuRAA0W_eljbaJbQ5nsTXbAHCjjVzsH5CjXdXqD-XRVH3KW74_Ota7emQ3bBV2TYhRR1dRzi48eKdrI8WpmOr-rUNcmJNDt-2dPbIzNxyC22whmLII8zHdoaE_txOb_Jc%3D)**

Hey, friend — I have some good and not-so-good news to share.
Thanks to this grassroots team, we've been running ads across Florida in English _and_ Spanish for a month now — and based on the numbers shared in our team meeting this morning, **they are working.**

## Trump, Harris Rally in Texas
Former President Donald Trump and Vice President Kamala Harris were in Texas Friday, with the election just over a week away. [Jim “Mattress Mack” McIngvale hosted a Trump rally](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0ULlyszAQfhrRLaMDgylU_A2d_zYls-gwGgvkkRZj3j5D4jbVbvHdX7fxhiGG9f4fF6fp7dMouWxAcJDtaDHEY2wqqydue1E5LTrZ9-raXa_VrK1SDk3jett2TdtZ56WZuFQeRcdbgVXQp5jgshVcKX6pp4lbz9XEjRDc94Y13NlAKdc0O3JvLD4e6eVybdJSRT0TPQtT_5gcmBz2fa9NDOYh57QVSuuJYnKwzoQS0gqnG5PD5wh-_hcmhwWJsisFFjQPoARzKgSUt-UJGWM8AAnuGKPLB_gtr4G27GBOWy4wOZ-ygwcuGBFmzDkU-AT4ZTM5VFnb5x5iDKXtWMPvC4b4U4L-XPWl5XcAAAD___5qfCo) at his Gallery Furniture store in Houston, dueling with Houston-native Beyonce’s appearance at a Harris rally in the same city. Meanwhile, [Trump spent the day in Austin](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00Luu4yAUheGngY6IW7ApKKZxl2mntMBswtaAiTC5vf1R0p96SeuT_n-X9eKx4H796yu48UptlVxqJjiTZo0ey3vVNLrAoxUUnJiktWqe5plmp0DJad4mpYNW2lgDOiUjrYdZB2ESRfc5E1wawZXi51MIPCauAt-E4MluRHOIOFo_jQwDXv5I5d0e0E9bq7S4PMbtIOoPkQuRy8iQsZTPRuSSW4UdngeRi7ZnpWfOnn5smRV8AItt9yWy0e_1xjpU3_8fDGvFa_cD285C6xE6O2C7dxxv9tWJXGh38fbEUvAwE9H8Wj1-STp-7fNw8icAAP__iFhphg), making remarks on border security before sitting for an interview with podcaster Joe Rogan. The Former President's presence [spurred road closures](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L3O3CAQheGrwd2sYIz_Coo07jZtSgvDsB4JGwvwZvfuI6f_6ld6dHT-PJen5cjH67fdydRPSAtK1KAkYL94y_G76MabVfpJNWTUgNPUjsM4NpsZaQqj8tMw9I46ch0OrW47i0pbvfa6YXNjSmKvZNvK7rGu0gfZrtIpJcPkhJbkuab8qBtV-tgS4je9KT9c2ptotlrPItpfAmeB85aSj3zQHQXOty1wVlLgTJ-TXIWabQjswFO03wIh5Z0ynJkKezrufu0nFHhz4QrlvHKBnKwHF1O5MhXgA0q66gb2KpUPgXOTjT__coxc-kFo-dotx__76o-HvQ3-CwAA__-vnG95) in South Austin. Harris’ and Trump’s appearances in the state is largely seen as an effort to boost their party’s candidate in the Senate race between Rep. Colin Allred (D) and incumbent Sen. Ted Cruz (R), as polls currently give Trump a comfortable 6-point lead in the state.
## Texas No. 1 in Job Creation
The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics released a report this week saying that [Texas led the U.S.](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L1uwyAUxfGnwRvW5UJMPDB08ZauHa3LV0KFTWRIHL99lezdj35H-v9c5gulnNbrNy3BtFcsMwIqLoDjMHtK-ZhV540FP4ouGKFxHOVZn8_dzShScnQDnbxwWkc5uMErgXgi6RBRd8m8MQE4CJASTr214CNIC04IiKNjCoJPrWx9u4UWXlRjPsozbL0rS5fNrbV7ZfKL4cRw2ve9j-VlHzWtodb3huEUXFnLcjCcPgDPgXzlj8p_i-VuC9RSWfkb5XeqjR-Btm4z_r6nnFMdNFNwXSjlz2f7N8LT4F8AAAD__yEfYKA) in job creation over the past year, adding 327,400 jobs. [Texas’ job growth](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OgzAQhJ_GdBut1wTiwsU1dLn2SrTGBvbk4Ais_Lz9yemvnm8-jebnOl5ZkmzLN9-iK685j4TUgkagbgws6T22TXAeg9VNdLona82lv1ya1Z01o7dTP3U8cW_Ymy5YIu_nzsYZTSOuyjRSp9EYPJ-8xzCj8ThpjbOdVIsxSMn7qayxxBcfc3rnR9xPU741ya2l3A9lvhQNioY155BkizVUNFS3okGjouHThRQ5HFDWCBsXyRvIBr_Zw7LnZ1mBQ5BtgeoHQz0gItzzIRU9KsvwjrwrGprdhftTUpKj61WLy40lfTaVf096OPoLAAD__10oaTQ) broke its previous employment records and far outpaced the next highest job-generating states: California, adding 265,300 more jobs; and Florida, adding 204,700 more jobs. Gov. Greg Abbott called Texas “[America’s job engine](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7FuhDAQBb_GdEbrNTG4cJGG7tKmRIu9cI4MPmGLu_v7KPSp39OM5vs23SimuK9ftLGrryVPCNhJBRLNFCim99Q1wc0QrGrYqR6t1UM_DM3dLYoNaWsHr73RZgiKlFad6QGpH9g20f3BFKBRoDV8tPMMYQE9g1cKFutFBxxizUdb71z5RWVJ73zy0fq8Ncnda30UoT8FjgLHNZ_tdWrXfAocd34WgeMjlypwvBYZ8hZ3qlwkFUkbH9FTkT95LpL3Ne7cHC48njGlWEwvOlg3iunS1X_7T4e_AQAA___Vgl4L)” in a statement, saying that “ _America's leading businesses are fleeing the stranglehold of over-regulation in other states_ ” and coming to Texas. Texas has added 2.4 million jobs with Abbott as governor.
## List: The Best Tacos in Texas
Texas Monthly has released its list of [the 50 best tacos and taquerias in Texas](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD3P4yAQhH8N7rCWNf6goLjGXa690gKzxEjYRGYVJ__-lLz1W440z2j0_LstN5dyOu5_3U6WX7EsCKilAonDElzK70U3wXoIRjVk1YjGdNM4Tc1mDfTkpn4MniAorQYzeh-iisZ5r71pkv2MKcBBQddB33oPIULnYVUKolmFBgqJy9nyRkwvV2N-lyed7Vr2JtuN-VFF90fgLHC-rqs96KpXOulTEDh_osD5i8q9HLzltzwpk6tUZeIqc6osS5S8kexBeqos2a2lynTIHw5R69502Jw2PK6Uc6rDKDTcd5fy9wn_quZp8X8AAAD__16nZ58), based on the 14,000-mile search by the publication’s award-winning taco editor José R.
