Peter, I will never forget the day Donald Trump became president. My godson came up to me with tears in his eyes. I assumed one of the other kids who had joined our watch party had been teasing him about something. **My godson’s voice was trembling: “Auntie Kamala, that man can’t win. He’s not going to win, is he?”** His worry broke my heart. I did not want anyone’s child to feel that way. I carry my godson’s voice -- and millions of voices just like his -- in my heart every day. Because what is at stake in this election shouldn’t be taken lightly. With just 10 days left before Election Day, I am asking you to pause and remember. Remember how you felt when Donald Trump entered the Oval Office. Remember the fear, the chaos, and the corruption of his first term. _Now, remember the relief we all felt when we defeated him._ Let that memory fuel you, Peter. **We can win again, but not without your help. In this final stretch, I am counting on my most dedicated supporters in Cresco to power our efforts to knock on doors, reach undecided voters, and let the American people know exactly who _we are._ ** clean_body: Peter, I will never forget the day Donald Trump became president. | | | Peter, I will never forget the day Donald Trump became president. My godson came up to me with tears in his eyes. I assumed one of the other kids who had joined our watch party had been teasing him about something. My godson’s voice was trembling: “Auntie Kamala, that man can’t win. He’s not going to win, is he?” His worry broke my heart. I did not want anyone’s child to feel that way. I carry my godson’s voice -- and millions of voices just like his -- in my heart every day. Because what is at stake in this election shouldn’t be taken lightly. With just 10 days left before Election Day, I am asking you to pause and remember. Remember how you felt when Donald Trump entered the Oval Office. Remember the fear, the chaos, and the corruption of his first term. Now, remember the relief we all felt when we defeated him. Let that memory fuel you, Peter. We can win again, but not without your help. In this final stretch, I am counting on my most dedicated supporters in Cresco to power our efforts to knock on doors, reach undecided voters, and let the American people know exactly who we are. Did you know that America's most popular diaper brands, including Huggies, Pampers, Hello Bello, and Honest Co., all support abortion?

# FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Reader, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

Over this past year, while running for Congress and working for California residents as an Assemblywoman, I’m proud to tell you about a few more bills I authored which were signed into law. Here are a few more examples of the progress my team and I made this year:
* **Addressing Antisemitism on College Campuses (AB 2925)** makes sure that colleges include training on the top five groups experiencing discrimination and hatred in the State in their existing anti-discrimination and diversity programs. This will create safer and more inclusive spaces for all students, and for the first time help ensure that antisemitism is included in these training programs. As we see increases in antisemitism across California, I have been working closely with my colleagues in the Legislative Jewish Caucus and stakeholders including the Jewish Public Affairs Committee to ensure that all students are welcome and safe at college.

* Many housing developments near transit were paying high traffic impact fees, even though they create less traffic. **Lowering Traffic Fees for Housing Near Transit (AB 2553)** makes it easier to build affordable housing by reducing traffic impact fees for more housing developments. It also redefines a “major transit stop” to reflect post-COVID service levels so more housing developments automatically qualify for reduced traffic impact fees.

* **The Poison-Free Wildlife Act (AB 2552)** places restrictions on the use of the most dangerous types of rat poisons that are affecting non-target wildlife at alarming rates. This new law creates stronger rules to protect animals such as Griffith Park’s famous mountain lion P-22, who suffered from rodenticide poisoning. It also allows the Attorney General to prosecute those who willfully break the law

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95884079/508197034/1793776944?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20241026_f_WarnockMessageNOR_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNTJjNzFiZi1iYjkzLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bj-ScejY_Eox9v0hrkDZulS_ze7KFS4gG0PiDEVK3c8=&emci=8c083b93-1793-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=c52c71bf-bb93-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=1037277)

| | I have never been prouder of Georgia. Even as we face attempts to squeeze the people’s voices out of our democracy, the people of this state refuse to let our voices and our votes be silenced. Over 2 million Georgians have already voted in this election, and many more will do so before early voting ends November 1. With changes to our election rules coming down to the wire, voting early is our best bet to ensure record turnout in numbers too big to cry fraud. In 2020 and 2021, Fair Fight helped drive record-breaking voter turnout among Georgians, particularly young voters and voters of color — flipping the Peach State blue for the first time in decades. Cynics said it wasn’t possible, but together we proved them wrong. We have the power to do it again, and to make the promise of democracy real for us all. I was there, and I’ll never forget that feeling, knowing Georgia was taking a step into the future. We will not and can not let Donald Trump and his allies cut away at our democracy by blocking voters and disregarding our voices. We refuse to be silent when they undermine election certification. This year’s election is pivotal: it will determine whether we move forward as a nation or lose our democracy piece by piece. clean_body: | | | I have never been prouder of Georgia. Even as we face attempts to squeeze the people’s voices out of our democracy, the people of this state refuse to let our voices and our votes be silenced. Over 2 million Georgians have already voted in this election, and many more will do so before early voting ends November 1. With changes to our election rules coming down to the wire, voting early is our best bet to ensure record turnout in numbers too big to cry fraud. In 2020 and 2021, Fair Fight helped drive record-breaking voter turnout among Georgians, particularly young voters and voters of color — flipping the Peach State blue for the first time in decades. Cynics said it wasn’t possible, but together we proved them wrong. We have the power to do it again, and to make the promise of democracy real for us all. I was there, and I’ll never forget that feeling, knowing Georgia was taking a step into the future. We will not and can not let Donald Trump and his allies cut away at our democracy by blocking voters and disregarding our voices. We refuse to be silent when they undermine election certification. This year’s election is pivotal: it will determine whether we move forward as a nation or lose our democracy piece by piece. That’s why, from now until November 1, we must educate voters on their power and mobilize turnout. November 5 is the last day to vote, but we’ll work right up until the polls close. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: it’s a faster way to communicate
body:
Dear Peter,

With November right around the corner, the Abortion Goliath is coming at young voters from every angle.

They’ve got Big Media in their pocket and celebrity endorsers telling everyone who will listen how great abortion is . . .

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/_lPddkiUyqWl5HeF2wRGHw~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo__C5WixSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA
But we have fired-up youth volunteers who are ready to FIGHT to turn out the pro-life youth vote!

The only problem is that I may have to tell them I don’t have the resources to put them to work! 🫤

So, can I count on your most generous contribution to help us cover the costs of our voter texting program
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/JzCnqC7Mdv2DCU6lXjVGmg~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo__C5WixSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA
?

I’m sure you’re as sick as I am of getting political texts.

But the truth is, they DO work to turn out voters – if they’re sent by real people willing to have real conversations.

The problem is, it costs roughly $0.06 to contact a voter this way – considering the costs of data and the texting platform.

Our student volunteers have the time and the ability to help!

But the one thing no college or high school kid has is money.

That’s why I’m coming to ask for your help today.

Recently, I got sent some photos of a few students heading to Arizona all the way from California – a SIX-hour drive for them!

And while they were on the way, they spent every second they could sending text messages to young pro-life voters, urging them to get out and vote.

These students know just how important it is to win in every Battleground and Referendum State we can to defeat the Abortion Lobby in 2024 – and they’re willing to spare no effort to make sure that happens!

So, please agree to your most generous contribution to Students for Life Action right away
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/GcYvBFUG6aWXDpOq1-vlVQ~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo__C5WixSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA
!

So much is at stake this November, but I’m hopeful for the future because of the amazing students we have in the Pro-Life Movement.

And all of this couldn’t happen without your generous support.

So, thank you for all you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins

Check out how she opened up the night below: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95886245/508202977/248097932?s=46&t=MGAD-Lsr_lCzTP8QeAJqmQ&ms=241026_ty_debate&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYmI4M2IxZC1iZTkzLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8KZzwMuRBY-dSF9oMaqUCYDLD-kb6tMaO2_lMrcXz40=&emci=c7f140f9-6c92-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=0bb83b1d-be93-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=45157234) That's not all. I wish he would respect mine to make my choices about my body as a woman in this country." _ **On gun violence and safety for our children:** **Zink** \- _"Those are mental health issues."_ **Yass** \- _"Every country in the world is plagued by mental health crises. The difference is the easy and unrestricted access to guns and assault weapons in particular are weapons of war."_ Yass didn't hold back last week, and when she gets to Congress she won't either. ## What does immigration reform look like?
---
Peter Ohtaki
---
America’s been built through immigration. My grandparents legally immigrated from Japan to Hawaii and the West Coast in the early 1900s. The Nisei generation including my father and uncles fought for America in World War II while their families were held in internment camps. They overcame discrimination by becoming prominent dentists, doctors, farmers, and businessmen to build a better life for their families.
#### **Americans are compassionate and are willing to share the American dream**
Americans want to allow those who seek a better life, like my grandparents, to enter this country through controlled, legal immigration. However the sheer numbers are now overwhelming our social safety net - nearly 300k in one month (Dec 2023). At least 3 million since the lifting of Rule 42 (required asylum seekers to wait outside the U.S due to the pandemic until their asylum hearing) and nearing 10 million since 2021.
---
|
---
#### **The uncontrolled border is now a humanitarian crisis**
_How can we support the sheer volume of new migrants with housing and healthcare until they make a go of it?_ California provides MediCal to undocumented residents at a cost of over $700 million per year, while facing an $87 billion deficit. [New York City spent $4.9 billion](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=671d2724c2349c6c1bebce5a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fnypost.com%2F2024%2F08%2F13%2Fus-news%2Fnyc-migrant-crisis-costs-will-crack-eye-popping-5-billion-on-shelters-security-and-food%2F&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_671b37ce57322762aecd446e&l=en-US&s=0ytwY797140zhc_zZNhAYhESCYI%3D) in FY 2023 and 2024 on the migrant crisis.Border patrol is completely overwhelmed at current volumes of migrants. So it seems reasonable that we need to temporarily shut the border, while Congress and DHS gets their sh*t together.
#### **Comprehensive immigration reform is long overdue**
* Reform the asylum request process,
* Hire more border patrol agents,
* Repair and extend the wall with surveillance technologies,
* Enforce a **guest worker** program so migrants will pay taxes to help pay for social safety net benefits, as proposed in 2007 by the Bush administration, a Z visa allowing temporary work in the U.S. And with Z visa IDs, we could identify criminals.

Comprehensive immigration policy would stop the cartel’s human trafficking business. Migrants pay cartels about $15,000 to guide them to the gaps made in the border.
#### **Drug cartels control the border**
Drug cartels especially the [**Sinaloa cartel**](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=671d2724c2349c6c1bebce5a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mainstreamrevolution.com%2Fs%2FSinaloa-Cartel-map%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D671b37ce57322762aecd446e%26ss_email_id%3D671d2724c2349c6c1bebce5a%26ss_campaign_name%3DWhat%2Bdoes%2Bimmigration%2Breform%2Blook%2Blike%253F%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-10-26T17%253A30%253A23Z&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_671b37ce57322762aecd446e&l=en-US&s=5bwTltQHAtgDzo5Jcyi8POu1w48%3D) must be prosecuted by Mexico, with American military assistance. In 1973, President Richard Nixon launched the Drug Enforcement Agency (DEA) and the War on Drugs. We took down Pablo Escobar. The Sinaloa cartel began smuggling marijuana into the U.S. 113k Americans died of fentanyl last year according to [NewsNation](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=671d2724c2349c6c1bebce5a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.newsnationnow.com%2F&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_671b37ce57322762aecd446e&l=en-US&s=6xoNQYEFU0Fq9zWlpvkyQ4vyB74%3D). In August, the Mexican Navy apprehended 7 tons of cocaine destined for the U.S. As then Senator Kamala Harris said, “Wow, you’re saying we’ve lost the War on Drugs.” Right now the cartel is going through a [war of succession](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=671d2724c2349c6c1bebce5a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.yahoo.com%2Fnews%2F19-suspected-cartel-members-killed-103800186.html&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_671b37ce57322762aecd446e&l=en-US&s=GQIC8fPGlee-b_xSGHF3feOy19Q%3D) after the U.S. arrested both “El Chapo” Joaquin Guzman and “El Mayo” Zambada - an opportune time for the Mexican government to prosecute the Sinaloa cartel.
---
|
---
#### **Security risk of an uncontrolled border**
We also need to screen migrants from **China, Venezuela,** and**Tajikistan**.
* Tajikistan (neighbors Afghanistan) presents a terrorism risk. In June, Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) arrested 8 Tajiks who the FBI alerted had ties to **ISIS-Khorasan (ISIS-K)** \- the ISIS affiliate killed 13 US soldiers and 170 Afghans at Kabul airport during our withdrawl 3 years ago on August 26, 2021.
* Nearly 5 million have left Maduro’s socialist Venezuela, and many have come here. Venezuelan gangs have expanded here, and the Treasury Dept sanctioned [**Tren De Aragua (TdA)** , a violent Venezuelan gang](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=671d2724c2349c6c1bebce5a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.newsnationnow.com%2Fus-news%2Fimmigration%2Fborder-coverage%2Fcartels%2Fvenezuelan-gang-special-threat%2F&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_671b37ce57322762aecd446e&l=en-US&s=BuG-2rTt2m8XqJKAF9-dOurEYl8%3D) took over several apartment complexes in Aurora, Colorado, and is suspected in more than 100 police investigations around the U.S. TdA members attacked New York City police officers in January, and murdered University of Georgia student Lakin Riley and 59-year-old Angel Samaniego in Stamford, CT.
* **Chinese fentanyl pre-curser ingredient** companies are setting up final additive operations in the U.S.

#### **Mass deportation is not the answer, but rather** _**targeted**_**deportation of criminals**
It’s impossible and inhumane to deport 30 million undocumented migrants, most working peacefully in this country. However, ICE reported to Congress as of July 2024, there are [425,431](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=671d2724c2349c6c1bebce5a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.newsweek.com%2Fice-damning-border-report-kamala-harris-visit-1960689&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_671b37ce57322762aecd446e&l=en-US&s=iO-AY4eWxKnowVDWQNc7n0lT9tg%3D)[ convicted criminal migrants – and 222,141 with pending criminal charges](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=671d2724c2349c6c1bebce5a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.yahoo.com%2Fnews%2Fnetwork-evening-newscasts-barely-mention-153134974.html&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_671b37ce57322762aecd446e&l=en-US&s=7GsJietEH13XZX-5-weLgiurUjw%3D) who crossed the U.S. southern border illegally. Of these 425,431 convicted criminals, 62,231 have been convicted of assault, 14,301 convicted of burglary, 56,533 have drug convictions and 13,099 have been convicted of homicide. An additional 2,521 have kidnapping convictions and 15,811 have sexual assault convictions. These 425k must be deported.

clean_body: Mainstream Revolution What does immigration reform look like? Peter Ohtaki America’s been built through immigration. My grandparents legally immigrated from Japan to Hawaii and the West Coast in the e | | | | What does immigration reform look like? Peter Ohtaki America’s been built through immigration. My grandparents legally immigrated from Japan to Hawaii and the West Coast in the early 1900s. The Nisei generation including my father and uncles fought for America in World War II while their families were held in internment camps. They overcame discrimination by becoming prominent dentists, doctors, farmers, and businessmen to build a better life for their families. Americans are compassionate and are willing to share the American dream Americans want to allow those who seek a better life, like my grandparents, to enter this country through controlled, legal immigration. However the sheer numbers are now overwhelming our social safety net - nearly 300k in one month (Dec 2023). At least 3 million since the lifting of Rule 42 (required asylum seekers to wait outside the U.S due to the pandemic until their asylum hearing) and nearing 10 million since 2021. | The uncontrolled border is now a humanitarian crisis How can we support the sheer volume of new migrants with housing and healthcare until they make a go of it? California provides MediCal to undocumented residents at a cost of over $700 million per year, while facing an $87 billion deficit. in FY 2023 and 2024 on the migrant crisis.Border patrol is completely overwhelmed at current volumes of migrants. So it seems reasonable that we need to temporarily shut the border, while Congress and DHS gets their sht together. Comprehensive immigration reform is long overdue Reform the asylum request process, Hire more border patrol agents, Repair and extend the wall with surveillance technologies, Enforce a guest worker program so migrants will pay taxes to help pay for social safety net benefits, as proposed in 2007 by the Bush administration, a Z visa allowing temporary work in the U.S. And with Z visa IDs, we could identify criminals. Comprehensive immigration policy would stop the cartel’s human trafficking business. Migrants pay cartels about $15,000 to guide them to the gaps made in the border. Drug cartels control the border Drug cartels especially the must be prosecuted by Mexico, with American military assistance. In 1973, President Richard Nixon launched the Drug Enforcement Agency (DEA) and the War on Drugs. We took down Pablo Escobar. The Sinaloa cartel began smuggling marijuana into the U.S. 113k Americans died of fentanyl last year according to . In August, the Mexican Navy apprehended 7 tons of cocaine destined for the U.S. As then Senator Kamala Harris said, “Wow, you’re saying we’ve lost the War on Drugs.” Right now the cartel is going through a after the U.S. arrested both “El Chapo” Joaquin Guzman and “El Mayo” Zambada - an opportune time for the Mexican government to prosecute the Sinaloa cartel. | Security risk of an uncontrolled border We also need to screen migrants from China, Venezuela, andTajikistan. Tajikistan (neighbors Afghanistan) presents a terrorism risk. In June, Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) arrested 8 Tajiks who the FBI alerted had ties to ISIS-Khorasan (ISIS-K) \- the ISIS affiliate killed 13 US soldiers and 170 Afghans at Kabul airport during our withdrawl 3 years ago on August 26, 2021. Nearly 5 million have left Maduro’s socialist Venezuela, and many have come here. Venezuelan gangs have expanded here, and the Treasury Dept sanctioned took over several apartment complexes in Aurora, Colorado, and is suspected in more than 100 police investigations around the U.S. TdA members attacked New York City police officers in January, and murdered University of Georgia student Lakin Riley and 59-year-old Angel Samaniego in Stamford, CT. Chinese fentanyl pre-curser ingredient companies are setting up final additive operations in the U.S. Mass deportation is not the answer, but rather targeteddeportation of criminals It’s impossible and inhumane to deport 30 million undocumented migrants, most working peacefully in this country. However, ICE reported to Congress as of July 2024, there are who crossed the U.S. southern border illegally. Of these 425,431 convicted criminals, 62,231 have been convicted of assault, 14,301 convicted of burglary, 56,533 have drug convictions and 13,099 have been convicted of homicide. An additional 2,521 have kidnapping convictions and 15,811 have sexual assault convictions. These 425k must be deported. | 8 Politzer Drive, Menlo Park, CA 94025, USA Powered by

Caroleene, alongside her husband Bobby, is the proud parent of two daughters, Philippa and Lydia. Derek — Four
years ago today, Supreme Court Justice Amy Coney Barrett was sworn in with
a lifetime appointment.

In a hyper-partisan, last-minute confirmation hearing as millions of votes
in the 2020 election were being cast, Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell
denied the late Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg’s dying wish. In shockingly
hypocritical fashion, and after Mitch McConnell denied so much as a
confirmation hearing to Merrick Garland for nearly a full year after
Antonin Scalia’s passing, McConnell and Senate Republicans jammed Barrett
onto the bench within 6 weeks of Biden’s election.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2024_abs_em.0Y0BaT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20241026_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=8020%2E5257348%2EFsgw-Z ]Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell stacked the Supreme Court. I’m not
willing to allow my kids to live an entire lifetime under this right-wing
majority — I’m running for Senate to reform our Supreme Court, and I
promise to vote to confirm judges we can trust to protect our rights and
uphold the Constitution. The next president may nominate as many as three
new Supreme Court justices, and we need a Democratic Senate to confirm or
reject them. Please,
Derek, chip in to my campaign.

After Trump and Mitch McConnell jammed through three Supreme Court
justices, trust in the court has plummeted, and its ethically-conflicted
justices have done unbelievable harm to our rights and freedoms.

* They overturned Roe v. Wade.
* They ruled Trump would have presidential immunity from most criminal
charges if he were to make it back to the White House.
* They rejected gun safety, environmental protections, student loan debt
cancellation, and countless other Biden administration priorities.

This anniversary is a sobering reminder of what could happen if Donald
Trump secures a second term in the White House and if Republicans flip
control of the U.S. Senate.

More far-right judges — not just in the Supreme Court but at all levels.
More conservative rulings, sending our country back in time. More chances
at giving MAGA Republicans a free pass to implement their Project 2025
agenda and alter our democracy as we know it.

Derek, we have
to stop this. The Supreme Court is fundamentally broken, and our hopes of
making any progress on abortion rights, voting rights, gun safety, the
environment, and more could be shattered beyond repair if we let the
far-right movement have its way with the bench.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2024_abs_em.0Y0BaT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20241026_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=8020%2E5257348%2EFsgw-Z ]Chip in to make sure I can fight for a fair, just Supreme Court from

| | **Budzinski, Loyd square off in race for Illinois 13th Congressional District**
_— Fox 2 Now, October 14, 2024_
* * *
_[Budzinski] has [gotten] several big efforts [across] the finish line, including bringing back millions in infrastructure funding for the district. She worked with Republicans on some of those projects to secure the money. But she has run into partisan gridlock that has defined the past two years in congress. As a member of the house agriculture committee, the two parties haven’t been able to agree on a farm bill._ _**“What actually moved out of our House Agriculture Committee under Republican leadership, unfortunately, I felt like was a very deeply partisan bill that played geographic favorites,** meaning that the farm bill that they moved out of committee actually, I believe disproportionately impacted southern commodities like cotton, rice, peanuts,” Budzinski “We don’t grow a lot of that in the Midwest. We grow corn and soybeans. **I want a Farm Bill that’s equitable, that’s going to support our family farmers.”**_ | [PITCH IN NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95890321/508214765/1483068346?refcode=AU_NJB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC120_20241026_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YWU0N2MwZC1jNzkzLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-aSPfqS5Iy1G2B459MocxPtvDMx6W9-HuqokUGX7ddU=)

Every day she goes to Washington, Nikki genuinely seeks collaborative solutions with her fellow Democrats and even reaches across the aisle when it matters. Real progress happens when common sense prevails, and cross-party cooperation isn't just a buzzword but a **reality**.
But this Farm Bill isn't that. The GOP pushed it through the House Agriculture Committee, and it sorely misses the mark for our communities. SNAP benefits are slashed, farmer safety nets are weakened, and essential climate protections are axed from conservation funds.
We need a Farm Bill that supports the Midwest — this one leaves us high and dry. It became a playground for partisan games, blatantly disregarding the real needs of millions.
**[Changing this means taking back the House majority and fortifying our Democratic presence in the House Agriculture Committee. As a member of the house agriculture committee, the two parties haven’t been able to agree on a farm bill. “What actually moved out of our House Agriculture Committee under Republican leadership, unfortunately, I felt like was a very deeply partisan bill that played geographic favorites, meaning that the farm bill that they moved out of committee actually, I believe disproportionately impacted southern commodities like cotton, rice, peanuts,” Budzinski “We don’t grow a lot of that in the Midwest. We grow corn and soybeans. I want a Farm Bill that’s equitable, that’s going to support our family farmers.” | = Every day she goes to Washington, Nikki genuinely seeks collaborative solutions with her fellow Democrats and even reaches across the aisle when it matters. Real progress happens when common sense prevails, and cross-party cooperation isn't just a buzzword but a reality. But this Farm Bill isn't that. body:
Gloria Johnson is ready to fight for us.

| | 🗳️ **KEY ELECTION DATES FOR TENNESSEE** 🗳️ **Election Day:** November 5
**Early Voting:** Now – October 31
**Absentee Ballot Request Deadline:** October 29
**Deadline for mail ballot return:** Tuesday, Nov. 5
---
Gloria Johnson is the kind of leader Tennessee needs, and she’s ready to bring real change to the U.S. Senate.
Gloria is a breath of fresh air for American politics. She’s a fighter who won’t back down, whether it's standing up for working families, defending our democratic values, speaking out for victims of gun violence, or confronting the climate crisis head-on.
Both my father and I served Tennessee in the U.S. Senate. In Washington, you need grit and determination to fight for what’s right. I see those qualities in Gloria. She’s the kind of leader who won’t bow to special interests but will fight relentlessly for Tennesseans.
But here’s the thing: Gloria is up against Marsha Blackburn, a politician who is bankrolled by Big Oil and has consistently put corporate interests over the well-being of Tennesseans. We simply cannot afford to have more leaders in Washington who deny climate science and ignore the urgent need for action.
We have an important opportunity to expand our Senate majority in November, but it’s going to take every single vote to make it happen. With less than two weeks until Election Day, we have no time to waste. Now is the time to make your plan to vote.
Here’s how you can help Gloria win:
1. **Mark your calendar:** Make your plan to vote early and ensure your voice is heard.
2. **Help spread the word:** Talk to your friends, family, and neighbors about how important this election is. Every single vote matters.
3. **[Volunteer to get out the vote:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95890649/508215651/692360227?refcode=ea.6fa9984b-c893-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.6fa9984b-c893-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZmE5OTg0Yi1jODkzLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jhsmZRuqnocZMD7oFQOpv-SUcZlN2kM9YpTz4beBfSo=&emci=83c5c882-d192-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=6fa9984b-c893-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=46764483)** There are so many ways you can help—from phone banking to knocking on doors, you can make a real difference in Gloria's campaign.

Let’s make sure Gloria Johnson has the support she needs by turning out in record numbers this fall.
Thank you for standing with us.
Best,
Al Gore
45th Vice President of the United States
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95890663/508215667/209297649?refcode=ea.6fa9984b-c893-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.6fa9984b-c893-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZmE5OTg0Yi1jODkzLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jhsmZRuqnocZMD7oFQOpv-SUcZlN2kM9YpTz4beBfSo=) Gloria Johnson is running for the U.S. Senate because Tennesseans deserve leaders who care.

---
|
As you know, our campaign is fighting for a better future for our community. To ensure that our message reaches every corner of our district, we’ve launched our billboard campaign, are releasing TV ads, and have been running radio ads left and right.
---

---
| Our campaign has clearly ruffled some feathers with our intense ground game, vast presence, and impactful messaging. We’ve recently had a number of signs vandalized, along with Harris/Walz sings throughout the district. We’re running a grassroots campaign through and through while our opponents and their supports decide destroying property is the right way to send their message.
---

---
| [**Can you donate $50, $100, or $250 dollars to help us defeat Ben Cline and reach more voters?**](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=57a0ed0bf1&e=0fced71d8c)

Luckily, we've still got 10 days before the polls close, but we can't waste a single second of the time we have left. = | | = I won't lie — this was always going to be a tough race. After all, I am up against a Republican who used $64 million of his own money to buy this seat in 2018. But this time, he's dead-set on enacting a dangerous agenda as the next Senate GOP leader, which includes criminalizing abortions nationwide, axing Social Security and Medicare, and raising taxes on hardworking families ... and he's already outspent me by over $15 MILLION to do it. So with just 10 days left to ensure he never gets the chance, your $10 donation could make all the difference: Just $10 will help me keep my ads on the air. Just $10 will help me recruit canvassing volunteers. Just $10 will help me win over critical undecided voters. Just $10 will help me retire Rick Scott and save our Senate majority. I know I've got what it takes to win, but I can't do it without the resources to get out every last blue vote on the ground. So in the final days of an election as important as this one — where the fate of the Senate, and so much more with it, hangs in the balance — every single dollar counts tenfold. And ahead of my last and most important end-of-month fundraising deadline this Thursday, it's going to take nothing less than a TIDAL WAVE of grassroots support to reach my ambitious $10 MILLION goal. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue. | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you for sticking with me, Debbie | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Hey there,
**The U.S. Senate is a country club.** It’s full of millionaires, former business execs, lawyers with Ivy League degrees, and trust fund kids born with so many silver spoons in their mouths that they have no idea the reality for working-class people like me.
**If I defeat my opponent Republican Senator Deb Fischer in November, I will be the poorest member of the U.S. Senate.** I don’t come from money, and I’m not rich. I’m a steamfitter and mechanic who works 50 and 60 hour weeks to give my kids a better life.
**I will be the only senator without a college degree.** After my wife and I found out we were expecting a baby, I had to drop out and kill my dream of hanging a diploma on the wall because my family needed health insurance, diapers, and food on the table.
**I will be the only senator who is a blue-collar, card-carrying, union member.** When Kellogg’s tried to cut our benefits and workers’ pay, we risked it all, went on strike, and walked the picket line for 11 weeks through the bitter cold Nebraska winter. We won and saved hundreds of good-paying jobs – before I was fired for being the union president who led the strike.
There is no one who represents working-class people like me in the U.S. Senate. Which is why this is such big news: **Five brand-new polls show I am narrowly LEADING my opponent Republican Senator Deb Fischer. And FiveThirtyEight now says this is the CLOSEST Senate race in the entire country!**
I’ve taken on a big corporation before and won, and now I’m going to defeat one of the most corporate senators – my opponent Republican Deb Fischer – and win this Senate seat. But I need your help to do it.
**We’ve set a goal of raising another $200,000 before our next fundraising deadline at midnight tonight, but I’m not taking money from corporate PACs like my opponent. If I’m going to defeat Republican Deb Fischer and win this Senate seat, I need grassroots donors like you to give right now:**

**Why the Trump Knife Collection Stands Apart:****8 Distinctive Knives, Each Telling a Story**

| | | ****
**An Heirloom for Generations**
****
****This collection is more than a tribute to Trump’s presidency—it’s an heirloom piece that captures a moment in history with elegance and pride. Each knife's patriotic theme is carefully chosen to resonate with the values that define America: freedom, strength, and resilience.

Displayed together, they create a narrative that will be admired for generations.

This isn’t just about owning knives; it’s about curating a piece of history.

**Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. I am pragmatic about politicians. I never fault any human being, especially politicians, for pursuing self-interest. Politics is a bloodsport. And it attracts and retains only the toughest, most brutal people obsessed with survival - whatever charming masks they may wear to conceal this.
Similarly, I expect voters to enforce the right incentives. Like anyone in the private sector, politicians and journalists simply respond to incentives. Neither were ever _solely_ public-spirited: Walter Cronkite was revered for real journalism, but he only did that because he _knew_ he would be revered for it. Today, he would be ridiculed for "both sides-ism."
Thanks for reading Pai's Politics! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9wYWlwb2xpdGljcy5zdWJzdGFjay5jb20vYWNjb3VudCIsInAiOjE1MDc2OTg1MSwicyI6MTExNzMwLCJmIjp0cnVlLCJ1Ijo5MDUwMTE5MiwiaWF0IjoxNzI5OTc0MDA1LCJleHAiOjE3MzI1NjYwMDUsImlzcyI6InB1Yi0wIiwic3ViIjoibGluay1yZWRpcmVjdCJ9.tyUt63Ar0Y4BrMQIcNc4uuN9BA7AcjCCD7ij5jazoVk?)
What we used to have, and increasingly don't, is an incentive structure that rewards public figures for pursuing the public good - even if it requires personal sacrifice. Getting caught in a lie used to be bad, because people used to be insulted when lied to. Now, we expect it.
Apology used to be a sign of respect. Now, it's a sign of weakness and stupidity.
Politicians aspired not just to getting elected and staying elected, but to being perceived as statesmen and stateswomen, or even more humbly, public servants.
Idealism without illusions means focusing on the incentives society creates. Don't expect people to be unselfish. Set up a society that makes doing the right thing = the selfish thing to do. Both by punishing people who poison the commons, and rewarding good stewards of a good society. As of now, American politics does neither.
We deserve two presidential nominees worthy of the presidency. We have none.
I don't think Trump is a fascist. He's merely a narcissistic sociopath. And I don't think Kamala is entirely incompetent. Just mostly.
I could be wrong about one or both of those things. I don't know.
What I know is neither deserves to be president.
And America, for all its flaws, deserves better than that.
--
_P.s._
_I was watching this old interview of Bill Clinton on Arsenio Hall last night, and was amazed by his candor, intelligence, and genuine concern for the well-being of ordinary Americans._
_Clinton 's lifelong treatment of women is morally abhorrent and allegedly criminal. (Again, I don't expect much from our leaders; beggars can't be choosers.) But his work ethic, vision, and performance as presidential candidate and president were exemplary. _
_I was a 1-month old baby in Bombay when Bill announced his underdog campaign for president. And yet, somehow, I sorely miss him._

clean_body: Idealism without illusions | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more Idealism without illusions | | | Oct 26 | | | | | | | | | | | | I am pragmatic about politicians. I never fault any human being, especially politicians, for pursuing self-interest. Politics is a bloodsport. And it attracts and retains only the toughest, most brutal people obsessed with survival - whatever charming masks they may wear to conceal this. Similarly, I expect voters to enforce the right incentives. Like anyone in the private sector, politicians and journalists simply respond to incentives. Neither were ever solely public-spirited: Walter Cronkite was revered for real journalism, but he only did that because he knew he would be revered for it. Today, he would be ridiculed for "both sides-ism." Thanks for reading Pai's Politics! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work. ? What we used to have, and increasingly don't, is an incentive structure that rewards public figures for pursuing the public good - even if it requires personal sacrifice. Getting caught in a lie used to be bad, because people used to be insulted when lied to. Now, we expect it. Apology used to be a sign of respect. Now, it's a sign of weakness and stupidity. Politicians aspired not just to getting elected and staying elected, but to being perceived as statesmen and stateswomen, or even more humbly, public servants. Idealism without illusions means focusing on the incentives society creates. Don't expect people to be unselfish. Set up a society that makes doing the right thing = the selfish thing to do. Both by punishing people who poison the commons, and rewarding good stewards of a good society. As of now, American politics does neither. We deserve two presidential nominees worthy of the presidency. We have none. I don't think Trump is a fascist. He's merely a narcissistic sociopath. And I don't think Kamala is entirely incompetent. Just mostly. I could be wrong about one or both of those things. I don't know. What I know is neither deserves to be president. And America, for all its flaws, deserves better than that. -- P.s. I was watching this old interview of Bill Clinton on Arsenio Hall last night, and was amazed by his candor, intelligence, and genuine concern for the well-being of ordinary Americans. Clinton 's lifelong treatment of women is morally abhorrent and allegedly criminal. (Again, I don't expect much from our leaders; beggars can't be choosers.) But his work ethic, vision, and performance as presidential candidate and president were exemplary. I was a 1-month old baby in Bombay when Bill announced his underdog campaign for president. And yet, somehow, I sorely miss him. Thanks for reading Pai's Politics! Fellow Patriot,

**At West Point, we had a code: cadets don't lie, cheat, steal, or tolerate those who do.**

_First the New York Times lied about my childhood and family, and now CNN is lying about my business record._

And what's worse, they are doing it all because _I 'm within striking distance of an entrenched career politician, Bob Casey, in the #1 swing state in the nation that will determine control of the U.S Senate._

**Bob Casey is getting Leftist news sources to do his dirty work, and I WON 'T TOLERATE IT.

Here's the truth: this is a long message and I hope you will read all the way to the end.**

I grew up in Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania. We lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road.

I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms.

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=cd9362f3126941eb97e50e001ea19eef&_e=XvOqV82gJQqZ3Zxv9Szn2prtglJSVPQlOhRao43BEM_38k5bkJAZ4uTlESKM3ibh0Bl10mTjGCJTe4wxw2z7Z5RG4TQeTismkw26pimiTjt6uI15XS-wkTXSQF-t6t5oRU9iiHZAtMrjbXTXzBmY0jdzEo6dPyQPp8SrTK27dyswi7Ms-OJR3OvG47tTBdTbQflNOnoeGhukWS8xrHs-NTLdvKRYmM_OQCVTelLlkLt6LxiTZyGV8zcCCKPVOKIsI89ZkUxrOk0fslqkP7Zji26_2mMXW88HxgWxOSERrUPd6DEV-7BQ78KrEv6-BsVTcrtr0m-mYIfcgEHAU1_kFhdA3bEgQmoBeA2I2WIbdyyPyoQ8jmszaMGKkSil7kPUUMbp4sK1fFYEeJEZaQf5fpREqJECIl7OMqc-DCMYTg0%3D)

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=cd9362f3126941eb97e50e001ea19eef&_e=XvOqV82gJQqZ3Zxv9Szn2prtglJSVPQlOhRao43BEM_38k5bkJAZ4uTlESKM3ibh0Bl10mTjGCJTe4wxw2z7Z5RG4TQeTismkw26pimiTjt6uI15XS-wkTXSQF-t6t5oRU9iiHZAtMrjbXTXzBmY0jdzEo6dPyQPp8SrTK27dyswi7Ms-OJR3OvG47tTBdTbQflNOnoeGhukWS8xrHs-NTLdvKRYmM_OQCVTelLlkLt6LxiTZyGV8zcCCKPVOKIsI89ZkUxrOk0fslqkP7Zji9y1Hg9pMVO-gSiL2o2yHFU07H6G07WF8cS7NvWydA_idFcdr4lBc2Qnc6rIqRRe9BEcLLTTOCTLZM8QMTTr49MXJK1Gc_zOOG3hg1gS7c0ob0XvhTzEtYG-yDfx5_7pCI6bCgXPONl1PP-Mu_rITqk%3D)

My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh.

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=cd9362f3126941eb97e50e001ea19eef&_e=XvOqV82gJQqZ3Zxv9Szn2prtglJSVPQlOhRao43BEM_38k5bkJAZ4uTlESKM3ibh0Bl10mTjGCJTe4wxw2z7Z5RG4TQeTismkw26pimiTjt6uI15XS-wkTXSQF-t6t5oRU9iiHZAtMrjbXTXzBmY0jdzEo6dPyQPp8SrTK27dyswi7Ms-OJR3OvG47tTBdTbQflNOnoeGhukWS8xrHs-NTLdvKRYmM_OQCVTelLlkLt6LxiTZyGV8zcCCKPVOKIsI89ZkUxrOk0fslqkP7ZjixJfIAw2NLtbaQ5l6V7X1ctojuvY6Np-CAdDz4SkCYl_q_BOmwVbClAQ9TeFHzivxGkdBfddwozFtIdl3n1V0_ioxxw_bAx8soOE6hkZIsBz0_ld63Ba0TLfhV7hUT3wyQgmNxai1ruACNkS1yZwZQI%3D)

I'm incredibly proud that my dad was chosen to be president of Bloomsburg State College (now Bloomsburg University) at only 34 years old.

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=cd9362f3126941eb97e50e001ea19eef&_e=XvOqV82gJQqZ3Zxv9Szn2prtglJSVPQlOhRao43BEM_38k5bkJAZ4uTlESKM3ibh0Bl10mTjGCJTe4wxw2z7Z5RG4TQeTismkw26pimiTjt6uI15XS-wkTXSQF-t6t5oRU9iiHZAtMrjbXTXzBmY0jdzEo6dPyQPp8SrTK27dyswi7Ms-OJR3OvG47tTBdTbQflNOnoeGhukWS8xrHs-NTLdvKRYmM_OQCVTelLlkLt6LxiTZyGV8zcCCKPVOKIsI89ZkUxrOk0fslqkP7Zji05LrwOCIqMFwZGh-eGXy_vwvJWs-g4L2ZL1oLrS7IczTtV_PfFahzRexL6AvMsc4NYPgIDd3MgZlp_ziI04CiJU398WRmjtXzMDo2qS8n1QR2Xl9pI1XTYd8jfR1a_Rtn69CRnkWpu_QbCiy4N58Tc%3D)

clean_body: Please read this full message Fellow Patriot, At West Point, we had a code: cadets don't lie, cheat, steal, or tolerate those who do. First the New York Times lied about my childhood and family, and now CNN is lying about my business record. And what's worse, they are doing it all because I 'm within striking distance of an entrenched career politician, Bob Casey, in the #1 swing state in the nation that will determine control of the U.S Senate. Bob Casey is getting Leftist news sources to do his dirty work, and I WON 'T TOLERATE IT. Here's the truth: this is a long message and I hope you will read all the way to the end. I grew up in Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania. We lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road. I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms. My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh. I'm incredibly proud that my dad was chosen to be president of Bloomsburg State College (now Bloomsburg University) at only 34 years old. I'm so proud of my parents' teaching careers and to have been raised in Bloomsburg. It was there that I wrestled and played football and was nominated to the U.S. Military Academy at West Point. And it was there that I came home to a parade after serving in combat during the Gulf War. After the Army, I earned a Ph.D. in international relations before moving to Pittsburgh to start a career in business. I worked my way up to become the CEO of FreeMarkets, a successful tech startup that employed hundreds in Western Pennsylvania. I was then called to service again, this time in the highest levels of government as Under Secretary of Treasury and as Deputy National Security Advisor. Following this, I joined Bridgewater Associates, one of the largest, most successful investment firms in the world, which manages the pension plans of groups including teachers, firefighters and law enforcement. I have lived the American Dream, and I am running for Senate to bring my decades of experience and love for our country to fix our broken economy that is a direct result of policies supported by my opponent, who has spent 18 years in Washington with NOTHING to show for it. I knew getting into this race could mean things would get nasty, but it 's sad to see we've fallen so far that these media outlets like the New York Times and CNN are pushing the Democrats' baked narrative about my upbringing and my business record. I've opened myself and my family up to attacks from the left, and every day feels like a battle. But I'm no stranger to fighting for what is right and if we don 't elect leaders to go to DC to clean up the mess the career politicians made, we will lose America as we know it! Here's where I need your help, Fellow Patriot. We need to combat these lies with the TRUTH about me. The Democrats are seeing the same polls you and I see. They know if Kamala Harris and Bob Casey lose Pennsylvania, they lose it ALL, and they are going to do WHATEVER IT TAKES to try and defeat me. I hate asking for money -- I'm not a career politician, and it's not in my nature -- but I have no choice but to ask if we're going to hit our fundraising goal for the final stretch of the campaign. Chuck Schumer and his allies are working overtime to obliterate my campaign. They have committed to spend whatever it takes to defeat me. They know if I win this race in Pennsylvania, it 'll be IMPOSSIBLE for Democrats to keep their majority in the Senate. If we don't show the Democrats we can win this race, it's game over. That's why I'm hoping you can spare Your donation will take us one step closer to victory, and I am so grateful for your support. Thank you, Dave McCormick P.S. Democrats from all over the country are pouring money into this race to defeat me because they know this race could flip the Senate red. Paid for by Friends of Dave McCormick. name: Brown, Sherrod
subject: we may have to cancel our last TV ad
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY FRIENDS OF SHERROD BROWN
body:
I just talked to my campaign manager
| | |
---
Friend, I need you to hear this: **I just talked to my campaign manager, and she said our final TV ads might not make it on the air.**

subject: Is Donald Trump anti-war?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20241026_trump&n=1)
---
Peter,

With the current administration leading the charge for Israel’s horrific genocide – now expanding into a broader, regional war – and fueling the war in Ukraine with no end in sight, Republicans are now working overtime to rebrand Donald Trump as a dove.

_The same Donald Trump_ who nearly kicked off a full scale war with Iran by assassinating General Soleimani.

_The same Donald Trump_ who, with Democratic support, co-signed a coup in Bolivia and attempted a coup in Venezuela.

_The same Donald Trump_ who set the stage for Israel’s bloodbath in Gaza and the West Bank by formally recognizing Jerusalem as Israel’s capital.

Donald Trump is many things. A predator. A crude bigot. A con man.

**But one thing Trump has never been is anti-war.**
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20241026_trump&n=2)
---
While Democrats railed against Trump’s domestic agenda (most of the time) throughout his term, in virtually every instance the “Vote Blue No Matter Who” crowd threw their full weight behind Trump’s constant foreign provocations – leaving very little daylight between them.

I’ve been calling out Donald Trump’s warmongering ways for as long as he’s been a figure on the national stage – particularly during his term in the White House.

[**Voters who truly want a peace president have only one choice on the ballot this year – our campaign. We are down to the final 10 days of this campaign to deliver our mandate for people, planet, and peace at the ballot box. Every dollar you give helps us reach one more voter on the fence. Will you contribute now?**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20241026_trump&n=3)

| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20241026_trump&n=4 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20241026_trump&n=4)
---
Donald Trump and his allies will try to rewrite history and make us forget his warmongering ways. But we know the truth.

We know that Trump and the Republicans are funded by the same weapons manufacturers and fossil fuel extractors as Democrats operating at every level of government.

They may dislike his uncouth rhetoric. They may finger-wag his racism. They may object to his weaponization of the courts and federal agencies (though they won’t hesitate to use the same in their own favor).

But in co-signing genocide, provoking endless wars, and serving the forces of the American empire, Democrats and Donald Trump fit together hand in glove.

**[Our only way free is to break the power of this warmongering corporate uni-party with an irrepressible movement for humanity. That is our message. That is our demand.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20241026_trump&n=5)**

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

**Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Peter,
I’m an actress, director, singer, longtime activist, and, above all, a citizen of our great democracy. And as a citizen with a platform larger than most, I believe it is not only my right but also my duty to express my concerns. So here goes Peter:
**I’m concerned by what I’m seeing in Pennsylvania and national Republicans’ ruthless efforts to unseat Bob Casey and flip this battleground red.**
If the GOP succeeds in flipping Pennsylvania red, they’ll almost certainly regain control of both the Senate _and_ the White House, threatening everything from voting rights to women’s rights to the fight against climate change.

body:
Peter,
Let's be real here: Floridians know all too well what creepy is.
**It's Rick Scott. He's a creep.**
It's creepy how intent he is on controlling women's bodily autonomy and reproductive choices. He has pushed time and again for a national abortion ban, and would lead the charge in getting such legislation signed into law if Donald Trump gets reelected to the White House.
It's creepy how he voted against the Right to IVF Act, which would have guaranteed federal protections for the procedure. And it's creepy how _he lied about that vote_ — spending millions of dollars on an ad buy saying he would protect access to that very procedure a day after he voted to do the opposite!
The U.S. Senate is one of our world's greatest democratic bodies. It's not a place for creeps and liars, particularly those like Rick Scott intent on pushing Trump's radical Project 2025 agenda.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

I don’t know if I’ll ever get used to watching a former president attack me personally. I grew up with next to nothing and one of the most powerful people in the world just calls me out at his rallies.
Folks,
I don’t know if I’ll ever get used to watching a former president come after me. I grew up with next to nothing and one of the most powerful people in the world just calls me out at his rallies.
That’s always going to be weird to me.
He came back because Arizona is critical to his chances this year, and winning this state is personal for him after we beat him back in 2020.
He knows if he can help defeat me he’s got an open path to the White House. He’s got to go through us to win.
That raises the stakes of our campaign beyond just one seat in the U.S. Senate, and beyond our Senate Majority. This race is about beating Trump, once and for all.

# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39219%2E3422442%2Ewf8B2u)
Derek,
Before I was hired at UC Irvine, I taught at University of Iowa. My sons Luke and Paul were born in Iowa, making them the seventh generation of Iowans in my family.
I still care deeply about that community in Iowa—in fact, in 2020 I went and checked on the fence I built myself around my little house. (It was standing, by the way.) It feels like home in a way, which is why I’m so excited to tell you about my friend Christina Bohannan.
Christina’s running for Congress in the same district I lived in and built that fence in, and she’s looking to build a _bit_ more: In Congress, Christina will fight every day for Iowa families, kids, and small businesses because she believes if you work hard, you deserve a fair shot to get ahead.
**Christina is exactly the kind of leader we need right now:[Will you chip in $5 or more right now to support Christina Bohannan and Truth to Power?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20241026-2?refcode=em20241026-39219&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39219_3422442_wf8B2u&akid=39219%2E3422442%2Ewf8B2u)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20241026-2?refcode=em20241026-39219&refcode2=39219_3422442_wf8B2u&akid=39219%2E3422442%2Ewf8B2u)
Christina is a mom, law professor, and former engineer. She’s running for Congress because she believes we need a government that works for the people, not Washington special interests.
